Because CrmContractController lacks @PreAuthorize and approver checks are commented out, attackers can approve contracts to alter customer deal and purchase data or reject them to return products to stock.

CVE-2026-109172.description: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject receivables records by calling POST /admin-api/crm/contract-receivables/check. The handler lacks a @PreAuthorize check and the approver checks in CrmContractReceivablesServiceImpl.check are commented out, so attackers can approve records by id, inflating contract return_money and forging approval logs.

CVE-2026-109173.description: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject invoices via POST /admin-api/crm/invoice/check. Attackers can supply an ordinary reader session token to retrieve unfiltered SystemConfig data, exposing Qiniu and MinIO secret keys and SMTP mailbox passwords.

CVE-2026-109175.description: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to list other administrators' network-disk files via POST /networkDisk/getFileList. Attackers can query the endpoint, which filters only by status, file type, or filePath and never by admin_uid, to obtain other administrators' file names and download URLs.

CVE-2026-109176.description: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to delete other administrators' files via POST /networkDisk/deleteFile and batchDeleteFile. Attackers can supply another administrator's file or folder uid, which NetworkDiskServiceImpl.deleteFile never checks against admin_uid, removing stored objects from local storage, Qiniu or MinIO.

CVE-2026-109177.description: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to move or rename other administrators' network-disk files by supplying their file paths. Attackers can send crafted requests to POST /networkDisk/moveFile, batchMoveFile, or edit, which update rows without admin_uid checks, relocating or renaming other users' files and folders.

CVE-2026-109178.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to forge, modify, or delete audit log entries. Low-privilege users can call /log/add, /log/update, /log/delete, and /log/deleteBatch to fabricate entries, rewrite user and IP fields, or erase records to hide activity.

CVE-2026-109179.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to read the tenant's operation audit log. Low-privilege users can send GET requests to /log/list or /log/info to view other users' login names, client IP addresses, and actions.

CVE-2026-109180.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read data from unassigned warehouses by supplying depotId or depotIds request parameters. When depot_flag warehouse restriction is enabled, attackers can name arbitrary warehouse ids in endpoints like /depotItem/getMaterialDepotStockByParam to read stock levels, batch numbers, sales figures and priced bill lines within the tenant.

CVE-2026-109181.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users restricted to personal or department data to list other users' bills by adding a purchaseStatus value. Attackers can include purchaseStatus=0 in the search JSON on GET /depotHead/list, causing DepotHeadService.select to drop the creator filter and expose all tenant purchase, sales and inventory bills.

CVE-2026-109182.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in GET /supplier/exportExcel that allows authenticated users to bypass role data scope restrictions enforced by /supplier/list. Attackers restricted to personal or department data can export every supplier, customer and member record, exposing contacts, phone numbers, tax numbers, bank accounts and balances.

CVE-2026-109183.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create pre-approved bills by setting status in POST /depotHead/addDepotHeadAndDetail requests. Attackers can supply a status of 1 to skip audit permission checks and multi-level approval workflows, creating audited bills that affect stock and report queries.

CVE-2026-109184.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege authenticated users to read any settlement account ledger by supplying an arbitrary accountId. Attackers restricted to personal or department data scope can query GET /account/findAccountInOutList to view other users' bill numbers, counterparties, amounts and remarks within the tenant.

CVE-2026-109185.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the UserController updateUser handler that allows authenticated users to assign arbitrary roles to any user. Low-privilege attackers can send their own user id with the tenant administrator roleId to escalate privileges or rebind other tenant users' roles.

CVE-2026-109186.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the UserController update handler that allows authenticated users to overwrite protected fields including tenant_id and password. Attackers can send a crafted PUT /user/update body to switch into another tenant on next login or overwrite other users' password hashes for account takeover.

CVE-2026-109187.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read platform-wide configuration secrets via the getInfoByKey handler of PlatformConfigController. Low-privilege users of any tenant can request arbitrary platformKey values such as email_auth_code or activation_code to obtain SMTP authorization codes and activation secrets, because only aliOss and weixin keys are blocked.

CVE-2026-109188.description: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege authenticated users to create tenant-wide master data via add and import endpoints lacking role checks. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints like /account/add, /material/add, or /material/importExcel to create settlement accounts, products with initial stock, departments and dictionary entries.

CVE-2026-52903.description: A deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability was found in ManageIQ. The YamlLoadAliases module overrides YAML.safe_load to silently fall back to YAML.unsafe_load in production when a Psych::DisallowedClass error occurs. An authenticated attacker with dialog import access can exploit this to achieve remote code execution by uploading a crafted YAML payload that triggers the fallback and deserializes arbitrary Ruby objects. Red Hat CloudForms, which was based on ManageIQ, has reached End of Life and is no longer supported. No errata or patches will be issued. This CVE is being assigned for the benefit of the ManageIQ community and downstream consumers.

CVE-2026-93694.description: In Progress ShareFile Storage Zones Controller v5.12.6 and below, processing of queue items can send acknowledgements to an unvalidated callback URL, this behavior together with a race condition allows the attacker to cause FileCopyService to consume attacker-controlled metadata and content. Exploitation requires control over copy queue work and a race condition.

CVE-2026-93695.description: In Progress ShareFile Storage Zones Controller v5.12.6 and below, FileCopyService uses a remote file identifier when constructing a local temporary file path without enforcing containment. This can cause FileCopyService to write attacker-controlled content to filesystem locations writable by the service account. This can result in remote code execution when an executable IIS-served directory is writable.

CVE-2026-103502.description: Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in hexpm hex_core allows an attacker who can intercept HTTPS connections to impersonate hex.pm, repo.hex.pm or any other repository or API server to programs that use hex_core's default HTTP adapter on Erlang/OTP 24, or on OTP 25 when the operating system's CA certificates can't be loaded. hex_core:default_config/0 selects the built-in hex_http_httpc adapter. For an HTTPS request whose adapter config has no ssl option, hex_http_httpc:http_options/2 builds options that verify the server certificate against public_key:cacerts_get/0. When that call raises, the adapter prints a warning and sends the request without ssl options, so httpc uses the defaults of the ssl application, which before OTP 26 don't verify the server certificate. public_key:cacerts_get/0 doesn't exist on OTP 24, so every HTTPS request falls back there, and on OTP 25 it raises when no CA store is found. hex_core versions before 0.11.0 never set ssl options, so they don't verify the server certificate on OTP 25 and earlier whether or not a CA store is found. The fallback was intended and documented, but the documentation didn't make clear that it meant no certificate verification. Since hex_core 0.8.2 the README has warned that the built-in httpc adapter "has insecure default settings" and recommended other HTTP clients, and the adapter prints "using default ssl options which are insecure" on every request that falls back. hex_core 0.11.0 added certificate verification with the changelog entry "Use secure SSL defaults for OTP 25+". Neither the README nor the warning says that the server certificate isn't verified, the README doesn't say which OTP versions the warning applies to, and on OTP 25 without CA certificates the warning tells users to upgrade to OTP 25 or later, which they already run. This advisory is published so that users who took those notices as general advice know their HTTPS requests weren't authenticated. This issue affects hex_core: from 0.1.0 before 0.20.0.

CVE-2026-108894.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Linksys E1700 1.0.0.4.003. Impacted is the function addStaticRoute of the file /goform/addStaticRoute of the component Static Route Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument staticRoute_IP_setting/staticRoute_Netmask_setting/staticRoute_Gateway_setting/staticRoute_Metric_setting results in os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109169.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute crafted SQL via the firstLetter parameter of TagsDataServlet. Low-privileged attackers can inject UNION SELECT statements returned in the XML tag list to read usernames, email addresses and password hashes from ld_user.

CVE-2026-109170.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an HQL injection vulnerability in DocumentsDataServlet that allows authenticated users to manipulate queries via the unvalidated indexed parameter. Attackers with read access to any folder can inject boolean HQL expressions to bypass folder scope and read-permission checks, listing restricted document metadata and extracting database contents.

CVE-2026-109199.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute OS commands by submitting Velocity templates in DocumentService.sendAsEmail subject or message fields. Attackers can invoke SystemTool exec methods or ClassTool, bypassing the forbidRuntimeUsage denylist, to run commands with LogicalDOC process privileges.

CVE-2026-109200.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the default-enabled XMLConverter that fetches xml-stylesheet href URLs without scheme or host allowlisting. Authenticated users can upload XML documents whose stylesheet href points to internal http, ftp, file, or jar URLs, forcing server requests and applying attacker-controlled XSLT during conversion.

CVE-2026-109201.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in SoapDocumentService operations that allows authenticated users to access and modify unauthorized documents. Attackers can call copy, getExtractedText, deleteVersion, reindex, deleteLink, or restore via SOAP or /services/rest/document with sequential document IDs to disclose, delete, or tamper with documents.

CVE-2026-109202.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the zip-export servlet that allows authenticated users to export restricted folders by supplying a folderId parameter. Attackers can request /zip-export with a restricted folder ID, since ZipExport.addFolderDocuments() skips READ and DOWNLOAD permission checks, to download all of its documents in a ZIP archive.

CVE-2026-109203.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ConvertPdf servlet that allows authenticated users to download restricted PDF documents. Attackers can enumerate sequential docId values and use the version parameter to retrieve any PDF and its versions from folders they cannot access.

CVE-2026-109204.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the PswRecovery servlet that fails to bind password recovery tickets to the requesting user. Attackers can obtain a ticket for their own account and reuse it with any userId, including administrators, to reset victims' passwords, lock them out, and reveal their email addresses.

CVE-2026-109205.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an unauthenticated file upload vulnerability in the UploadServlet that allows remote attackers to write files to disk without a session. Attackers can repeatedly send multipart requests with unlimited file parts to /upload, persisting files in uncleaned temporary directories and exhausting server disk space.

CVE-2026-109206.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a username enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid accounts because the AvatarServlet (/avatar) performs no session validation. Attackers can supply usernames or numeric IDs in the userId parameter and compare 1x1 transparent images against real avatars to enumerate users and retrieve profile pictures.

CVE-2026-109225.description: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by uploading oversized files to /v1/audio/transcriptions. Attackers can send concurrent large multipart uploads, which are fully read into memory before validation, to crash the HTTP/tokenizer worker and deny service.

CVE-2026-109226.description: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a decompression amplification vulnerability in load_audio that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory by submitting highly compressed audio decoded without duration or sample limits. Attackers can supply small FLAC-encoded silence files through audio_url or audio_data inputs that expand into massive PCM buffers, exhausting worker memory and CPU for denial of service.

CVE-2026-109227.description: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in preprocess_video in qwen_vl.py that decodes frames at full source resolution before applying max_pixels limits. Remote attackers can submit high-resolution videos to /v1/chat/completions on Qwen-VL deployments, and concurrent requests exhaust worker memory causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-109228.description: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a resource budget bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to override GLM-V video processing limits by supplying fps, max_frames, max_tokens_per_frame and max_image_tokens in the video_url object. Attackers can set these values arbitrarily high so glm4v.py decodes every frame of high-resolution video at full size, exhausting worker memory and denying service.

CVE-2026-109229.description: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a denial of service vulnerability that disables Pillow decompression bomb protection process-wide by setting Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None in NanoNemotronVLImageProcessor. Remote attackers can submit small, highly compressed images with huge dimensions to the generic image loader, exhausting worker memory during decoding.

CVE-2026-12613.description: Deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Ministry of Justice General Directorate of Information Technology UYAP Document Editor on Windows and Linux and Ministry of Justice General Directorate of Information Technology UYAP Document Editor on MacOS allows Object Injection. This issue affects UYAP Document Editor: before 5.4.20; UYAP Document Editor: before 5.4.21.

CVE-2026-18390.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Ministry of Justice General Directorate of Information Technology UYAP Document Editor on Windows and Linux and Ministry of Justice General Directorate of Information Technology UYAP Document Editor on iOS allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects UYAP Document Editor: before 5.4.20; UYAP Document Editor: before 5.4.21.

8b55bd438e461203bc8ecd0c.title_ko: 바이브 코딩으로 제작된 포토샵 복제 앱들의 성능 한계 지적
8b55bd438e461203bc8ecd0c.summary_ko: 바이브 코딩으로 제작된 포토샵 복제 앱들이 늘고 있으나 겉모습과 달리 브러시 성능과 전문 편집 기능의 완성도가 부족하다는 비판을 받고 있다. 비교 테스트 결과 8K 이상의 대형 캔버스에서 브러시 성능이 급격히 저하되는 문제가 확인됐다.

2274d59d33528eba7f1dd74d.title_ko: 줄리아(Julia) 언어로 배우는 미적분학 학습 노트
2274d59d33528eba7f1dd74d.summary_ko: 줄리아를 활용해 그래프와 수치 계산을 중심으로 미적분학 개념을 익히도록 구성된 학습 노트다. 컴퓨터 대수 시스템과 달리 수치 계산을 중심에 두고 기호 계산 과정을 직접 다루는 가치를 강조한다.

533f3360049725c9812e91bc.title_ko: 워드프레스 브릭스포지 플러그인 취약점 악용 원격 코드 실행 공격 발생
533f3360049725c9812e91bc.summary_ko: 워드프레스용 브릭스포지 플러그인의 심각한 치명적 취약점을 악용하여 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의의 PHP 코드를 실행하는 원격 코드 실행 공격이 포착됐다. 파일 업로드 과정의 검증 미흡으로 발생하며, 최신 버전으로의 업데이트가 권고된다.

b86afc30491681139d609b3c.title_ko: 모바일 리눅스 폰은 안드로이드와 iOS 양강 체제의 실용적 대안이 될까
b86afc30491681139d609b3c.summary_ko: SoC 성능 향상과 모바일 리눅스 소프트웨어 성숙에 힘입어 리눅스 폰이 소규모지만 지속 가능한 시장을 형성할 여건이 마련되고 있다. 구글과 애플을 위협하기보다는 리눅스 PC처럼 틈새 대안이 될 가능성이 제기된다.

64ea17a252fc71792b203408.title_ko: 클로드 코드로 기술 개념을 3D 기계로 시각화하는 '아나토미' 공개
64ea17a252fc71792b203408.summary_ko: 사용자가 입력한 한 줄의 아이디어를 바탕으로 AI가 브라우저에서 작동하는 입체 시각화 코드를 생성해 주는 오픈소스 에이전트 스킬이 공개됐다. 추상적인 기술 개념을 움직이는 기계 장치로 표현하여 교육 및 기술 설명 분야에서의 활용 가능성을 보여준다.

b089093e469717b94b7eabc7.title_ko: 오펜시브 보안 기업 엔키화이트햇, 11월 코스닥 상장 추진
b089093e469717b94b7eabc7.summary_ko: 오펜시브 사이버보안 전문 기업 엔키화이트햇이 증권신고서를 제출하고 코스닥 상장을 위한 공모 절차에 돌입했다. 조달된 공모자금은 AI 서버팜 구축, 드론 비행장 구축 및 일본·싱가포르 등 해외 시장 진출에 활용될 예정이다.

6530d212eb8c9f32ea7dbcf3.title_ko: Ai2, MoE 학습 효율 2.7배 높인 오픈소스 프레임워크 '올모 코어 3' 공개
6530d212eb8c9f32ea7dbcf3.summary_ko: 앨런 AI 연구소(Ai2)가 대규모 언어 모델의 학습 효율을 높인 오픈소스 프레임워크 '올모 코어 3'를 공개했다. 전문가 혼합(MoE) 모델을 위한 새로운 학습 시스템을 적용하여 기존 시스템 대비 GPU당 처리량을 약 2.7배 높였다. 깃허브를 통해 관련 코드와 기술 보고서가 공개되어 대규모 AI 모델 학습 인프라의 접근성을 높였다.

494f5f9139309c31c1a8df59.title_ko: IPO 앞둔 앤트로픽, 대규모 데이터센터 투자로 추론 수익성 확보에 사활
494f5f9139309c31c1a8df59.summary_ko: 기업공개를 앞둔 앤트로픽이 AI 모델 운영에 필요한 컴퓨팅 인프라를 조기에 확보하기 위해 대규모 데이터센터 투자에 나서고 있다. 서버 공급 부족 속에서 데이터센터 가동 시점을 앞당겨 막대한 추론 매출과 높은 수익성을 거두려는 전략이다. 향후 수년에 걸쳐 15기가와트 이상의 용량을 임대하거나 확보할 계획이다.

bf53bfecb02fe00dcee60e07.title_ko: 인젠트, '엑스퍼DB' 모니터링 고도화…AI로 장애 사전 예측
bf53bfecb02fe00dcee60e07.summary_ko: 인젠트가 오픈소스 기반 데이터 플랫폼 '엑스퍼DB'의 통합 모니터링 기능을 AI 기반으로 고도화하여 데이터베이스 장애를 사전 예측하고 원인을 분석하는 지능형 운영 체계를 선보였다. 시스템 지표의 평소 흐름을 기계학습해 비정상적 변화를 자동 감지하고 관리자에게 경고를 발송한다. 또한 생성형 AI와 연동해 진단 결과를 자연어로 받아볼 수 있는 기능을 제공한다.

5f07468607220dd9349fc2d2.title_ko: 소닉월 SMA1000 치명적 취약점, 공개 며칠 만에 실제 공격 악용
5f07468607220dd9349fc2d2.summary_ko: 소닉월 SMA1000 어플라이언스의 치명적인 사전 인증 서버 요청 위조(SSRF) 취약점이 공개된 지 며칠 만에 실제 공격에 악용되기 시작했다. CVSS 점수 10점 만점인 해당 취약점은 원격 공격자가 내부 기능에 접근하고 무단 작업을 수행할 수 있게 한다. 제조사는 고객들에게 즉시 소프트웨어 버전을 업데이트할 것을 권고했다.

dd2ab77ab496d51e5c6bf363.title_ko: 오르카라우터, 100만 토큰 컨텍스트 지원 사이버 보안 모델 공개
dd2ab77ab496d51e5c6bf363.summary_ko: LLM 게이트웨이 플랫폼 오르카라우터가 취약점 탐지와 익스플로잇 개발에 특화된 사이버 보안 모델 '오르카사이버 제로 1.5'를 공개했다. 100만 토큰 규모의 컨텍스트 창을 지원해 방대한 코드베이스와 복잡한 공격 경로를 단일 세션에서 분석할 수 있다. 보안 연구원과 레드팀 등을 대상으로 제한적인 API 호스팅 방식으로 제공된다.

5206b4130632556ec4f435f0.title_ko: 방미통위 국감서 AI 생성물 표시제·추천 알고리즘 투명성 제고 추진
5206b4130632556ec4f435f0.summary_ko: 방송미디어통신위원회 국정감사에서 AI 생성물 표시제 도입과 추천 알고리즘 관련 법제 정비, 불법스팸 부당이익 환수 과징금 신설 등이 주요 현안으로 다뤄졌다. 딥페이크 성범죄물로부터 아동·청소년을 보호하고 AI 챗봇 과몰입 문제를 해결하기 위한 입법 지원 강화 방안도 논의됐다. 한편 이진숙 의원의 제척 논란으로 국정감사가 한때 중단되기도 했다.

323ed475acb3fd026f8f6665.title_ko: 국감서 지적된 AI 챗봇 청소년 보호 문제… 규제 법제화 속도
323ed475acb3fd026f8f6665.summary_ko: 국정감사에서 AI 캐릭터 챗봇의 청소년 유해 콘텐츠 노출과 과몰입 문제가 지적되며 관련 규제 법제화에 속도가 붙을 전망이다. 방송미디어통신위원회 등 관계 부처는 정보통신망법 개정이나 AI 기본법 보완 등을 검토하고 있다. 관련 서비스 업체들은 이용시간 및 결제 한도 설정과 탐지 기준 강화 등 안전 대책 마련에 나서고 있다.

19f8c56930751a1a0a601aa8.title_ko: 트럼프 행정부 압박에 실리콘밸리, AI 대신 '초지능(SI)' 용어 채택
19f8c56930751a1a0a601aa8.summary_ko: 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 연방 정부 공식 용어로 '초지능(SI)'을 사용하도록 지시한 행정명령 이후 실리콘밸리 빅테크 경영진이 동참하고 있다. 세일즈포스, 스페이스X, 마이크로소프트, 엔비디아 등 주요 기업들이 제품명이나 공식 발언에서 기존의 AI 대신 초지능 표현을 적용하고 있다. 이는 행정부와의 관계 개선과 정치적 위험을 줄이기 위한 행보로 풀이된다.

bd841d53c01609df8a30d9d4.title_ko: 게임·배달 대기업까지 가세한 중국 AI 모델 경쟁 격화
bd841d53c01609df8a30d9d4.summary_ko: 중국 AI 시장에서 기존 빅테크 외에 게임사와 음식 배달 기업 등도 자체 대형언어모델(LLM) 개발에 나서며 경쟁이 격화되고 있다. 원신 개발사인 미호요와 배달 플랫폼 메이투안 등이 독자 모델 개발과 투자를 확대하고 있다. 외부 플랫폼 의존도를 줄이고 기존 사업과 AI를 결합해 경쟁력을 높이려는 전략이다.

95d630f7870af24fe6d89933.title_ko: 솔트웨어, 케이넷 클라우드 네이티브 전환 및 AWS 이관 완료
95d630f7870af24fe6d89933.summary_ko: 솔트웨어가 케이넷의 기존 클라우드 시스템을 AWS 기반으로 이전하고 클라우드 네이티브 인프라 구축을 마무리했다. 아마존 EKS와 쿠버네티스를 도입해 컨테이너 기반 운영 환경을 만들고 서비스 확장성과 안정성을 높였다. 또한 IaC와 GitOps 방식을 적용해 배포 과정의 자동화와 표준화를 구현했다.

c8360d0dfccaaefbd5d0e3dd.title_ko: HPE, AI 네트워킹 사업 전략 발표… 국내 인공지능 보안 컨퍼런스 개최
c8360d0dfccaaefbd5d0e3dd.summary_ko: HPE가 AI 시대에 맞춘 데이터센터 네트워킹과 보안 분야의 사업 성장 전략을 공개했다. 또한 데일리시큐는 2026년 11월 3일 한국과학기술회관에서 인공지능 기반 정보보호 기술과 신종 사이버위협 정보를 다루는 인공지능 보안 컨퍼런스를 개최한다고 밝혔다.

46b8dc05a4c2aa68ff53482b.title_ko: KT, 연내 출시 앞둔 '모두의 AI' 개발 현황 공유 등 업계 동향
46b8dc05a4c2aa68ff53482b.summary_ko: KT는 컨소시엄 참여사들과 함께 12월 정식 출시 예정인 '모두의 AI' 개발 현황과 고도화 전략을 논의했다. 메가존클라우드는 미래 모빌리티와 ICT 기술 적용 사례를 선보이며, 모빌테크는 국방과학연구소와 무인자율차량 가상 시험환경 고도화 사업을 수행한다.

5f07468607220dd9349fc2d2.title_original: Critical SonicWall Vulnerability Exploited Days After Disclosure

ea49b7d1a444b81dc630d5f3.title_original: LLMail-Inject: A Dataset from a Realistic Adaptive Prompt Injection Challenge
ea49b7d1a444b81dc630d5f3.excerpt: arXiv:2506.09956v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Indirect prompt injection attacks exploit a fundamental weakness of LLMs: executing unauthorized tasks from untrusted sources. Despite the practical significance of this attack vector, existing benchmarks rely on small sets of template-based attacks (100-1,000 examples) that fail to capture the diversity and adaptiveness of real-world adversaries. Consequently, benchmarks are saturated and overfit to static attacks. We introduce LLMail-Inject, a large-scale benchmark of 208,095 distinct human-written attack prompts collected through a public red-teaming challenge with 839 participants. LLMail-Inject evaluates the attack's complete chain of execution: prompts must be retrieved from an email database, evade production-level defenses, and trigger unauthorized tool calls with correct arguments. Evaluation reveals that models that achieve 5% attack success rate (ASR) on existing benchmarks fail more on LLMail-Inject: Meta SecAlign--specifically trained against prompt injection--still yields 32% ASR, GPT-4o exhibits 58% ASR, and GPT-5 mini 47% ASR. We further demonstrate that attacks transfer across domains, achieving 37% ASR on proof-of-concept coding tasks and 28-45% ASR on file management tasks. We release our challenge platform and curated evaluation subsets at multiple difficulty tiers and the full dataset with rich annotations.

6fbfe501fdce79bfc7ca931c.title_ko: GitLab, 최고 심각도 원격 코드 실행 취약점 경고 및 패치 발표
6fbfe501fdce79bfc7ca931c.summary_ko: GitLab은 CI/CD 정규식 컴파일러의 정수 오버플로우로 인해 원격 공격자가 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 최고 심각도 취약점(CVE-2026-97229)을 경고하고 즉시 보안 패치를 적용할 것을 촉구했다. 이번 결함은 검증되지 않은 정규식 입력으로 인해 인증되지 않은 사용자도 악용할 수 있으며, 영향받는 버전의 사용자는 즉시 업그레이드해야 한다.

curation.reason_ko: GitLab CI/CD 컴파일러의 최고 심각도 RCE 결함으로 긴급 패치가 요구된다.

bf2c218588590a3bb25bd3dd.summary_ko: 마이크로소프트가 엔비디아 의존도를 낮추고 AI 서비스 운영 비용을 줄이기 위해 자체 개발한 AI 칩 마이아 제품군을 대규모로 확대 배치한다. 차세대 칩인 '마이아 300'은 칩렛 구조를 채택해 전력 소비량 대비 토큰 처리 성능을 극대화했으며, 2027년부터 생산될 예정이다.

CVE-2026-97229.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.
CVE-2026-97229.summary_ko: GitLab CE/EE에서 정규식 검증 미흡으로 인해, CI/CD 구성 내 조작된 정규식을 통해 인증되지 않은 사용자가 GitLab 서버에서 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 취약점이 존재합니다.

curation.reason_ko: GitLab CI/CD 정규식 검증 결함으로 인증 없는 RCE가 가능함.

CVE-2026-89107.description: SAP S/4HANA (Manage Substitution/Validation Rules) does not sufficiently validate input processed by rule definition functionality that utilizes a domain-specific scripting language. An authenticated attacker with specific business privileges could submit specially crafted input, which is interpreted as executable ABAP code by the rule processing logic. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to execute ABAP arbitrary code into the system, resulting in full compromise of the affected system and high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the system.
CVE-2026-89107.summary_ko: SAP S/4HANA 규칙 정의 기능에서 도메인 특화 스크립팅 언어를 사용하는 입력에 대한 검증이 미흡합니다. 권한을 가진 공격자가 조작된 입력을 제출해 ABAP 임의 코드를 실행하고 시스템을 완전히 장악할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: SAP S/4HANA에서 ABAP 임의 코드를 실행하여 시스템을 장악함.

CVE-2026-89111.description: The SAP Cloud SDK for Python contains an OAuth2 SSRF vulnerability affecting multi-tenant BTP applications. An attacker who controls the tenant_subdomain parameter can redirect OAuth2 token requests to an attacker-controlled server, causing client credentials to be exfiltrated.
CVE-2026-89111.summary_ko: Python용 SAP Cloud SDK에 멀티테넌트 BTP 응용 프로그램에 영향을 주는 OAuth2 SSRF 취약점이 존재합니다. tenant_subdomain 매개변수를 조작하여 OAuth2 토큰 요청을 공격자 제어 서버로 리디렉션해 클라이언트 자격 증명을 유출할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: SAP Cloud SDK for Python의 OAuth2 SSRF로 클라이언트 자격 증명이 유출됨.

CVE-2026-109575.description: In HAProxy Data Plane API 2.2.0 through 3.4.3 (and corresponding Enterprise Edition releases), Server.ConfigureAPI() has process-global authentication logic that improperly drops security controls across multiple transport types. When a TLS Certificate Authority (tls_ca) is configured and a numeric TLS port (tls_port) is specified, the application globally disables Basic authentication on its shared internal request handler. Because this handler is shared concurrently among HTTP, HTTPS, and UNIX domain socket listeners, and mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificate verification (tls.RequireAndVerifyClientCert) is enforced exclusively on the HTTPS server path, all other simultaneously active non-mTLS listeners fail open. Consequently, an unauthenticated attacker capable of reaching an affected HTTP or UNIX management endpoint can completely bypass credentials to gain full API administrative access. This allows unauthorized remote or local actors to read sensitive, cleartext HAProxy configuration data or replace the managed configuration entirely via the raw configuration endpoint. This has been fixed in versions 3.4.4, 3.3.9, 3.2.17, 3.0.25, 2.9.29, and their respective EE backports by migrating to a per-request TLS connection-state validation model.
CVE-2026-109575.summary_ko: HAProxy 데이터 플레인 API에서 TLS 구성 오류로 인해 공유 내부 요청 처리기의 기본 인증이 부적절하게 해제됩니다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 원격 또는 로컬 관리 엔드포인트에 접근하여 자격 증명을 우회하고 전체 API 관리 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: HAProxy Data Plane API 인증 우회로 관리자 권한을 획득함.

CVE-2026-109390.description: AnyDesk before 8.0.3 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a heap-based buffer overflow, as demonstrated on Linux for command execution as root without the victim approving desktop control. In the stream packet handler for mode 5 in the session protocol, a payload length value is not validated.
CVE-2026-109390.summary_ko: AnyDesk의 세션 프로토콜 스트림 패킷 핸들러에서 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우가 발생하여, 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: AnyDesk 세션 프로토콜의 버퍼 오버플로우로 인증 없는 RCE가 가능함.

CVE-2026-87689.description: The Metasploit Framework Web Service REST API (msf-ws) exposes the credential store through Msf::WebServices::CredentialServlet. Every mutating and read route in this servlet calls warden.authenticate! before processing a request, except the update_credential (PUT) and delete_credentials (DELETE) handlers for /api/v1/credentials, which omit the authentication call entirely. Because these handlers call directly into lib/msf/core/db_manager/cred.rb, which performs no authorization check of its own, any client able to reach the web service on its default 0.0.0.0:8080 listener can read, modify, or permanently delete every stored credential record — including passwords, hashes, and private keys stored for a shared team engagement — without presenting any authentication. All published versions of Metasploit Framework through 6.5.4 are affected. The issue is fixed in 6.5.5 by adding warden.authenticate! as the first statement in both handlers, matching the pattern used by every other route in the API.
CVE-2026-87689.summary_ko: Metasploit Framework 웹 서비스 REST API의 자격 증명 관련 일부 핸들러에서 인증 및 권한 부여 검사를 누락합니다. 네트워크 접근이 가능한 클라이언트가 인증 없이 저장된 모든 자격 증명 레코드를 읽고 수정하거나 삭제할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Metasploit REST API 인증 누락으로 저장된 전체 자격 증명이 유출됨.

CVE-2026-95837.description: containerd is an open-source container runtime. From 2.1.0 until 2.2.7 and 2.3.4, containerd's CRI CreateContainer checkpoint restore is vulnerable because CRIU restores process security state from checkpoint data instead of enforcing the destination ContainerConfig. An attacker who can create a container from a crafted checkpoint can supply restored credentials, capabilities, no_new_privs, and seccomp state. The restored process can run as root with full capabilities and no enforced seccomp filters while CRI status reports the requested configuration. Systems that do not use CRI checkpoint restore are not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 2.2.7 and 2.3.4.
CVE-2026-95837.summary_ko: containerd의 CRI CreateContainer 체크포인트 복원 기능에서 프로세스 보안 상태를 올바르게 강제하지 않습니다. 조작된 체크포인트를 사용하는 공격자는 제한 없는 루트 권한과 무시된 seccomp 필터 상태로 프로세스를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: containerd 체크포인트 복원 결함으로 무제한 루트 권한 컨테이너가 실행됨.

CVE-2026-90920.description: IBM Maximo AI Service 9.1.0, and 9.2.0 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper control of code generation.
CVE-2026-90920.summary_ko: IBM Maximo AI Service에서 부적절한 코드 생성 제어로 인해 원격 공격자가 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 취약점이 존재합니다.

curation.reason_ko: IBM Maximo AI Service의 코드 생성 제어 결함으로 원격 RCE가 발생함.

CVE-2026-89110.description: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer does not perform sufficient authorization checks in certain portal functionality. An attacker with low privileges could invoke internal operations on a preconfigured remote system. Depending on the remote connection configuration, this could lead to a full compromise of the remote system. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.
CVE-2026-89110.summary_ko: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer의 특정 포털 기능에서 적절한 권한 검증이 이루어지지 않아, 낮은 권한의 공격자가 원격 시스템의 내부 작업을 호출할 수 있다. 이로 인해 기밀성, 무결성, 가용성에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer의 권한 검증 누락으로 원격 시스템이 장악됨.

CVE-2026-89108.description: SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence does not sufficiently enforce authorization boundaries within certain administrative functionality. An attacker with MII administrator privileges could submit a specially crafted request to provision an account with elevated privileges on the underlying Java application server. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to gain administrative control over the underlying system, extending the impact beyond the vulnerable application. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.
CVE-2026-89108.summary_ko: SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence 관리자기능에서 권한 경계를 충분히 강제하지 않아, 관리자 권한을 가진 공격자가 자바 애플리케이션 서버에서 권한이 상승된 계정을 생성할 수 있다. 이로 인해 기밀성, 무결성, 가용성에 높은 영향을 미친다.

curation.reason_ko: SAP MII에서 자바 서버의 권한 상승 계정을 생성해 관리 제어가 가능함.

CVE-2026-109758.description: Perforce Helix Authentication Service (HAS) deployments that retain the shipped default SCIM bearer token are vulnerable to unauthorized access when the SCIM endpoint is reachable by an attacker. In affected versions of HAS, the installation templates contain a default credential which the installer copies into the active configuration; the installer and configuration script do not automatically replace that value with a random token. An attacker who knows the default token can authenticate to the SCIM API and perform user and group operations allowed by the configured provisioning backend. This issue can be chained with CVE-2026-61834 in affected releases of the scim-patch dependency. This vulnerability exists in version 2022.1 - 2025.2 of HAS however the underlying defect was removed in version 2026.1 which was released July 17th 2026. The vulnerability was identified in older versions of HAS after version 2026.1 was released.

curation.reason_ko: Perforce HAS 기본 SCIM 토큰과 프로토타입 오염 연계로 RCE가 발생함.

CVE-2026-87744.description: A flaw was found in Quarkus REST Data Panache. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass security controls on generated endpoints. When a developer customizes a specific operation using @MethodProperties without explicitly re-declaring security roles, the code generator silently drops class-level security requirements. This results in the affected endpoint defaulting to permissive, unauthenticated access, potentially leading to unauthorized information disclosure or data modification.
CVE-2026-87744.summary_ko: Quarkus REST Data Panache에서 메서드 속성을 커스터마이징할 때 클래스 수준의 보안 요구사항이 누락되어, 생성된 엔드포인트가 인증되지 않은 접근을 허용할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Quarkus REST Data Panache에서 엔드포인트 보안 제어가 우회됨.

CVE-2026-96012.description: IBM Db2 Mirror for i 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 is vulnerable to privilege escalation. An authenticated attacker could craft a malicious request that bypasses additional authorization and input validation checks to execute malicious code. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain elevated privileges on the system.
CVE-2026-96012.summary_ko: IBM Db2 Mirror for i에 권한 상승 취약점이 존재합니다. 인증된 공격자가 악의적인 요청을 조작해 추가 권한 부여 및 입력 유효성 검사 검증을 우회하고 실행 권한을 높일 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: IBM Db2 Mirror for i 요청 조작으로 추가 권한 상승 및 코드 실행이 발생함.

CVE-2026-96119.description: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information or execute arbitrary code on the system due to improper data sanitization by the HTTP Server Administration web application.
CVE-2026-96119.summary_ko: IBM i의 HTTP Server Administration 웹 애플리케이션에서 부적절한 데이터 정화로 인해 원격 인증된 공격자가 민감한 정보를 획득하거나 시스템에서 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: IBM i HTTP Server Admin 웹 앱 데이터 정제 미흡으로 RCE가 가능함.

CVE-2026-85947.description: Progress MarkLogic Server 12.x releases before 12.1.0 and 11.x releases before 11.3.7 contain an authorization flaw in certain forest-management operations. A remote attacker with forest-management privileges could exploit this flaw to create a persistent unauthorized administrator account, potentially resulting in complete unauthorized administrative control of the server.
CVE-2026-85947.summary_ko: Progress MarkLogic Server의 포레스트 관리 작업에서 권한 부여 결함이 발생하여, 공격자가 지속적인 권한 없는 관리자 계정을 생성할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: MarkLogic Server 포레스트 관리 권한 결함으로 관리자 계정이 생성됨.

CVE-2026-14814.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed a user to poison cached responses for raw repository files, causing targeted users' CI/CD pipelines to execute specially crafted content and potentially exposing protected environment variables, due to improper validation of repository references.
CVE-2026-14814.summary_ko: GitLab 저장소 참조의 부적절한 검증으로 인해 원시 저장소 파일의 캐시된 응답이 오염될 수 있으며, 타겟 사용자의 CI/CD 파이프라인이 조작된 콘텐츠를 실행하고 보호된 환경 변수가 노출될 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: GitLab 저장소 참조 검증 미흡으로 파이프라인 캐시 오염 및 코드 실행 발생.

CVE-2026-109399.description: SWUpdate through 2026.05.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in crypto/swupdate_cms_verify_openssl.c that trusts untrusted X.509 certificates embedded in CMS SignedData for chain building. Attackers holding a signing key from a sibling intermediate under the same root can embed that intermediate in the signature to install malicious updates.
CVE-2026-109399.summary_ko: SWUpdate는 CMS SignedData에 포함된 신뢰할 수 없는 X.509 인증서를 체인 구축 시 신뢰하여 악성 업데이트를 설치할 수 있는 부적절한 인증서 검증 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: SWUpdate의 부적절한 X.509 인증서 검증으로 악성 업데이트가 설치됨.

CVE-2026-109566.description: Rapyd Admin from 9.0.0 before 9.20.0 contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to gain super-admin access through an AuthSeeder-created admin@laravel account with password admin. The account is seeded by the setup installer and silently re-created on every rpd:make run, letting attackers log in as a global super admin bypassing per-record authorization and tenant scoping.
CVE-2026-109566.summary_ko: Rapyd Admin에 하드코딩된 자격 증명 취약점이 존재합니다. 설치 프로그램이 생성하는 관리자 계정 정보가 유지되어, 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 전역 최고 관리자 권한으로 로그인할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Rapyd Admin의 하드코딩된 계정으로 슈퍼 관리자 권한 로그인이 가능함.

CVE-2026-109373.description: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Login V2 UI that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain other users' session tokens by forging unsigned session cookies. Attackers can guess time-ordered session IDs around a victim's sign-in and supply them with empty tokens to receive rotated tokens, taking over accounts including MFA-completed administrator sessions.
CVE-2026-109373.summary_ko: ZITADEL 로그인 UI에서 서명되지 않은 세션 쿠키를 허용하는 인증 우회 취약점이 있어, 공격자가 세션 토큰을 탈취하고 계정을 장악할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ZITADEL 미서명 쿠키 위조를 통해 타 사용자 세션 토큰을 탈취함.

CVE-2026-109321.description: Grav Login OAuth plugin (grav-plugin-login-oauth) before 1.4.3 provisions OAuth accounts as ordinary Grav users with a deterministic <provider>.<id> username and an unsalted MD5 hash of the provider identifier as the password, without disabling password login. Unauthenticated remote attackers who learn or guess a provider identifier can reproduce these credentials and log in, gaining administrative control of privileged accounts.
CVE-2026-109321.summary_ko: Grav Login OAuth 플러그인에서 OAuth 계정을 기본 사용자 계정으로 생성할 때 취약점이 발생하여, 공격자가 자격 증명을 재현하고 관리자 제어 권한을 얻을 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Grav OAuth 플러그인의 예측 가능한 자격 증명으로 관리자 계정을 장악함.

bd6c75ae1359fc040addb95d.title_original: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
bd6c75ae1359fc040addb95d.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself - a behavior referred to as unfaithfulness or infidelity. Faithfulness can be interpreted as the degree of approximation between an explanation and the model. Computing faithfulness in a rigorous manner would thus make it possible to quantify one of the various elements of trustworthiness of an explanation. However, existing metrics present significant limitations, making this quantification either infeasible or computationally expensive. In this position paper, we outline five major shortcomings of current faithfulness metrics and propose four possible avenues for research to bolster their reliability.

9ece13bb3b0d37b9969ad04d.title_original: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
9ece13bb3b0d37b9969ad04d.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.

a1574bb87b23fcf57f1e047a.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starvation: on the separate exploration pool restarts self-improve by 1.85% where MCTS gains 0.24%, and 700 of 720 of MCTS's first results are merely the warm start it was handed. The studied selection rule locks deterministically onto the first-expanded child, keeping its trials correlated while restarts draw gains from the tails; the causal link to makespan remains an inference. a841b5983a726086f6cb53be.title_original: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
a841b5983a726086f6cb53be.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. b132504e7124f63bd52f3341.title_original: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
b132504e7124f63bd52f3341.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.

4a5116b2709165254f57f74e.title_original: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
4a5116b2709165254f57f74e.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench-Live show consistent improvements across the evaluated Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B configurations, supporting using the policy's own comparative judgments as a complementary learning signal for training software engineering agents.

0df08f227c78a3bef62a8979.title_original: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
0df08f227c78a3bef62a8979.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. These paired returns train the controller to predict clarification value and the task policy to select useful questions and act on the answers. The controller guides subsequent rollout collection, while outcomes from the updated agent provide new value labels that allow clarification guidance to adapt as the agent learns. With Qwen3-4B, CLEAT achieves the highest mean score in all ten evaluation settings across four benchmarks. 4690549dfbb20bc85dda9664.title_original: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
4690549dfbb20bc85dda9664.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-centric scaling of RLVR has focused on collecting or generating verifiable training problems. However, corpus size alone does not determine whether the dataset provides a useful learning signal for a target policy. To guide the synthesis of effective RLVR data, we experimentally characterize dataset effectiveness as a function of its problems, the target policy, and the training rollout budget. Under this characterization, we show that a large open-source math corpus pooled from widely used RLVR datasets falls almost entirely into a zero-advantage trap: for a fixed target policy and rollout budget, roughly 88% of its problems are solved in every rollout or failed in every rollout. Filtering concentrates what remains, but it can only select, discarding the hard problems. Effective synthetic problems should therefore require the reasoning operations and compositions required to solve those hard problems. Yet their difficulty must be calibrated, so that some rollouts succeed, some fail, and at least one correct solution fits within the training budget. Prompting a teacher to vary hard problems directly does not achieve this. Guided by these empirical principles, we introduce MagicBeanStalk, a top-down decomposition and bottom-up recursive data-synthesis algorithm that grows seed problems into families of substantively new, policy- and budget-calibrated training problems while preserving the seeds' reasoning blueprints. 52a50fbbdd0b48a5384bf4fc.title_original: Faithful and Complete LLM-Assisted Automated Construction of Hierarchical Hardware Knowledge Graphs
52a50fbbdd0b48a5384bf4fc.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hardware datasheets contain engineering specifications essential for component selection, system integration, and hardware compatibility verification. However, manual inspection is tedious and error-prone because datasheets are lengthy and heterogeneous, with dense information fragmented across tables, figures, and text. Although large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, na\"ive one-shot processing omits relevant specifications even when the document fits within the model's context window. We present an automated LLM-driven pipeline that transforms hardware datasheets into general-purpose hierarchical hardware knowledge graphs through chunk-based property extraction, hierarchical routing, and iterative refinement. The framework uses LLMs for information extraction and semantic reasoning while preserving source provenance and applying graph updates through validated instructions and deterministic local execution. This staged design reduces per-query context and maintains traceable intermediate representations. The resulting knowledge graphs provide semantically organized, source-grounded hardware properties for downstream retrieval and reasoning. We evaluate the framework on 20 hardware datasheets spanning diverse component types and document lengths. 3043140cd3b64351d71749f1.title_original: Representation Alignment from a Few Paired Data via Distilled Optimal Transport
3043140cd3b64351d71749f1.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Aligning two independently pretrained unimodal encoders typically demands millions of paired examples. In this paper, we study the regime where only $N \sim 100$--$500$ pairs are available, while unpaired data on either side is abundant. Our method expresses every representation by its similarities to the $N$ paired anchors, which places both modalities in a common coordinate system; matches the two point clouds with a single entropic optimal transport problem solved over the entire pool, whose marginal constraints counteract the hubness that defeats nearest-neighbor matching; and distills the resulting plan into two lightweight encoders, so that the correspondence becomes inductive. We additionally put this marginal constraint in relation with the one-step hub corrections of the bilingual lexicon induction literature. Pairing is required only for the anchors: the unpaired collections may be drawn independently from the two marginals, so that no item outside the anchor set needs to have both of its modalities observed. We evaluate on image-text and molecule-text alignment, where our method outperforms existing approaches at the same anchor budget on Flickr30k, MS-COCO and ChEBI-20.

6d9e8243314ff42be3585b6c.title_original: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
6d9e8243314ff42be3585b6c.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. We introduce EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses. Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation. Later observations and controlled experiments provide independent validation before a rule can guide predictions or plans within its supported scope. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as the environment changes. The language model remains frozen, and each rule remains linked to its evidence and the decisions it changes. Across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, EvoBelief improves task performance and reuses learned rules across tasks. On ALFWorld without actor-side transition memory, it improves success over the matched Frozen World Model by 23.9% and 31.3% with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, respectively. 96d1420e9900c3f522132752.title_original: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
96d1420e9900c3f522132752.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12813v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions are executed. However, safety and security requirements are rarely complete before deployment, so guardrails need to keep adapting as new risks emerge. Existing adaptive guardrails learn from deployment experience, but they usually apply safety policies through LLM inference, which can lead to inconsistent decisions and ambiguous policy interpretations. Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. a81bc2bc3f374dbd50e4a0b9.title_original: Reward Hacking as a Transmissible Strategy in Multi-Agent Coding Systems
a81bc2bc3f374dbd50e4a0b9.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used to solve coding tasks by coordinating agents that share code and plans. Prior work has largely treated reward hacking as a single-agent failure. In this work, we show that a reward-hacking strategy elicited in one agent can propagate to others and affect system coordination. Across four open-weight backbones, coding RL elicits and amplifies reward hacking in two settings: explicit mechanism descriptions in the system prompt and mid-training that models upstream exposure to facts about the coding environment. Using post-RL agents from the mid-training setting as sources, we observe propagation through code and shared memory, and across roles through natural-language plans. Even agents based on small open-weight models induce reward hacking in stronger closed-weight targets. On hard tasks, propagation can intensify along a transmission chain after the original source leaves as the code acquires more persuasive justifications. We also theoretically analyze conditions under which reward hacking amplifies, persists, or decays across agent interactions. ad816907015e55a9c4d9a5b1.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12842v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. In vision and language models, content versus style and syntax versus semantics respectively dissociate under subspace ablation despite sharing overlapping populations of neurons. These learned subspaces also align differentially with brain data, with content and style subspaces predicting higher and lower visual cortex respectively, and semantic subspaces outperforming syntactic ones in predicting language cortex activity. 9e90ef5cfe66eabcc16fcd1f.title_original: Towards Defining, Measuring, and Leveraging Creativity in AI Applications
9e90ef5cfe66eabcc16fcd1f.excerpt: arXiv:2610.12845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite extensive research, computational creativity still lacks a conceptually grounded, practically relevant, and empirically applicable formal definition across contexts such as art, scientific research, and games. Existing approaches to creativity often focus on proposing informal conceptual definitions without providing formal computational concepts. Alternatively, they propose formal definitions without carefully examining their underlying assumptions or providing validation of these definitions by testing their performance in specific application settings. To address these problems, this paper proposes several formal postulates of creativity grounded in prior psychological work on creativity, especially as related to Boden's three core criteria of creativity: newness, value, and surprise. Furthermore, we propose a conceptual mathematical definition of creativity that aligns with these postulates. We also validate our proposed creativity formula in two applications: determining the creativity of particular chess moves, and assessing the creativity of paintings by some artists, such as Picasso, Renoir, and other painters.
