This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a site administrator to have preconfigured a Bit Integrations flow that binds the public Bit Assist webhook to a BuddyBoss "Send Notification" action with a form field mapped to notification_content, and the attacker to know the flow's UUID callback URL.

CVE-2026-102562.description: The AcyMailing plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the customField[] parameter of the public frontusers::subscribe endpoint in versions up to, and including, 11.1.0. This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping in the acym_cleanVar() sanitizer, whose HTML-tag stripper only matches complete tags (requiring a closing '>'), together with SubscriberInsertion::replaceUserInformation() and the archive view template, which substitute the stored subscriber field value into the mail body and emit it without HTML encoding. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses the online-archive URL for the poisoned subscriber, including administrators who click the plugin-generated link in the Subscribers → History screen.

This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with editor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. CVE-2026-89309.description: The authorization middleware of the WMS MobileServer fails to require authentication in two distinct cases. First, it only requires an Authorization header for GET and HEAD requests; requests using any other HTTP method are processed without an authentication check. Second, for any HTTP method including GET and HEAD, a request carrying a malformed or non-bearer Authorization header is passed through without a valid token being required. The middleware does validate a token whenever a well-formed one is present, but in these two cases it does not require one. A remote attacker with network access to the service can therefore invoke API functionality without valid credentials.

The file is served by the CDN with Content-Type: image/svg+xml and, when navigating directly to that URL, the script executes within the context of the CDN’s domain.

CVE-2026-109144.description: A vulnerability was identified in wbond certvalidator up to 0.11.1. This issue affects some unknown processing of the component Certificate Path Builder. Such manipulation leads to resource consumption. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109149.description: A weakness has been identified in beautifier js-beautify up to 1.15.1/2.0.3. The affected element is an unknown function. Executing a manipulation can lead to uncontrolled memory allocation. The attack may be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109152.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in jbardin scp.py up to 0.16.1. The impacted element is the function _recv_file/_recv_pushd of the component SCP Receive Handler. The manipulation leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 0.16.2 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 42fc3aaa71411daed60544e3b40179c1038bed5d. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

CVE-2026-109162.description: Forms using FileUpload or ImageUpload elements with a custom saveToFileMount configured stored uploaded files in the default storage folder 1:/user_upload/ instead of the configured destination. This could cause uploaded files to end up in a publicly accessible storage even though a restricted, non-public storage had been configured. Files stored this way are served directly, without the access checks applied to non-public storages. Forms that use the default value for saveToFileMount are not affected. This issue affects TYPO3 CMS versions 14.0.0-14.3.8.

CVE-2026-109854.description: A flaw was found in m17n-lib. An attacker who supplies crafted input to an application processing ISO-2022 encoded text can cause the library to read uninitialized memory from the stack. If the application exposes or returns the decoded output, this flaw can result in unexpected behavior and limited information disclosure.

CVE-2026-44415.description: Affected systems do not properly restrict access to internal APIs and paths for authenticated users. This could allow an authenticated remote attacker to access sensitive internal information, which in the worst case could be leveraged to facilitate unauthorized access to the system or result in the deletion of data.

CVE-2026-59241.description: A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC WinCC V7.5 (All versions), SIMATIC WinCC V8.0 (All versions < V8.0 Update 11), SIMATIC WinCC V8.1 (All versions < V8.1 Update 7). The affected application does not sufficiently restrict the permissions assigned to a database role. This could allow an authenticated remote attacker with database access to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands on the host system where SIMATIC WinCC is installed, potentially leading to a compromise of the system.

CVE-2026-63350.description: Affected devices do not properly restrict executable content contained in imported trace files. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.

CVE-2026-63351.description: Affected devices do not properly validate and sanitize visual properties of calculated signals contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering them on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.

CVE-2026-63352.description: Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal data contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering it on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.

CVE-2026-63353.description: Affected devices do not properly sanitize comment fields contained in imported trace files before rendering them on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.

CVE-2026-63354.description: Affected devices do not properly validate and sanitize visual marker data contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering it on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.

CVE-2026-63355.description: Affected devices do not properly sanitize signal names contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering them in selection menus on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Attacker-controlled JavaScript could be executed in the user’s browser session when the user subsequently interacts with an affected selection menu.

CVE-2026-63356.description: Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal names contained in imported CSV trace files before including them in error messages on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Attacker-controlled JavaScript could be executed in the user’s browser session when the resulting error message is displayed.

CVE-2026-63357.description: Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal data contained in imported calculated signal files before rendering it on the Trace page. This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the user’s browser session and perform PLC operations through the web server within the scope of the user’s authorization.

CVE-2026-72895.description: A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC IPC BX-21A (All versions < V31.01.13), SIMATIC IPC RW-543A (All versions < V1.1.4), SIMATIC IPC227G / IPC277G / IPC277G PRO / IPC327G / IPC377G (All versions < V28.01.15). A BIOS vendor test key is present in the UEFI Secure Boot key database. This could allow a local attacker with physical or administrative access to the device to boot an operating system or UEFI application signed with that test key, bypassing UEFI Secure Boot protections even when Secure Boot is enabled, potentially leading to a full loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the device.

CVE-2026-78556.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Industrial Edge App Publisher (All versions < V1.27.9). The affected software does not properly validate the server certificate when initiating a TLS connection. This allows an attacker to intercept and relay communication (Man-in-the-Middle attack) and to spoof a trusted entity by interfering in the communication path between the client and the intended server.

CVE-2026-78557.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Industrial Edge App Publisher (All versions < V1.27.9). The application fails to properly sanitize or escape data received from the backend before rendering it in the user interface. Because the front end is integrated with Node.js, this vulnerability allows for the execution of arbitrary JavaScript, which can be leveraged to achieve remote code execution (RCE) on the victim's machine

CVE-2026-85114.description: A vulnerability has been identified in .NET Client Library for SIMATIC S7 Webserver API (All versions < V3.3.61). Affected applications do not properly validate filenames received from remote servers during ticket downloads. This could allow an attacker who can manipulate the ticket response to write arbitrary files outside the intended download directory and, when overwriting is enabled, replace existing files accessible to the application.

CVE-2026-85115.description: A vulnerability has been identified in .NET Client Library for SIMATIC S7 Webserver API (All versions < V3.3.62). Affected applications do not properly redact PLC restore passwords from HTTP error exception messages. This could allow an attacker with access to logs or other diagnostic output to obtain the plaintext restore password and potentially perform unauthorized operations on the PLC.

CVE-2026-89196.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in facility names processed during the Bulk Import/Export workflow. This could allow an authenticated attacker with specific privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

CVE-2026-89197.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in the Value field of notification conditions processed during the Notification Profile configuration. This could allow an authenticated attacker with specific privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

CVE-2026-89198.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize the filename of firmware files uploaded to the system. This could allow an authenticated attacker with specific privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

CVE-2026-89199.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly restrict access to sensitive configuration items via specific database queries. This could allow an authenticated attacker to retrieve administrative credentials for various internal systems, leading to unauthorized information disclosure and privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-89200.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in the Name and Value fields for custom file labels. This could allow an authenticated attacker with administrative privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

CVE-2026-89201.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in device group or facility names processed during the Bulk Export workflow. This could allow an authenticated attacker with specific privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

CVE-2026-89202.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly perform authorization checks for device disconnection requests. This could allow an authenticated attacker with minimal privileges to disconnect active sessions of other users, including administrators, leading to a denial of service.

CVE-2026-89203.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly restrict access to various database queries, allowing users to retrieve system-wide information that is not intended for their privilege level. This could allow an authenticated attacker to gather sensitive information about the system's infrastructure, including details on all devices, substations, users, and scheduled activities.

CVE-2026-89204.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly restrict access to database queries used for subnet management. This could allow an authenticated attacker to read, modify, or delete subnet configurations, leading to unauthorized information disclosure and data manipulation.

CVE-2026-89205.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly perform server-side authorization checks for requests to schedule special operations. This could allow an authenticated attacker with minimal privileges to schedule unauthorized operations on devices.

CVE-2026-89206.description: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly perform server-side authorization checks for requests to modify the state of scheduled actions. This could allow an authenticated attacker with minimal privileges to retry, stop, or delete scheduled tasks without proper authorization.

CVE-2026-89208.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Capital Embedded AR Classic 431-422 (All versions), Capital Embedded AR Classic R20-11 (All versions < V2303), Desigo PXC00-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC00-U (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC001-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC100-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC12-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC128-U (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC200-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC22-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC22.1-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC36.1-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC50-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC64-U (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXM20-E (All versions >= V2.3). The affected product does not properly validate input bounds before accessing packet data. This could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to trigger memory reads outside the intended packet boundaries.

CVE-2026-109153.description: A vulnerability was detected in MosaicML Composer up to 0.32.1. This affects the function tarball.extractall of the file composer/utils/checkpoint.py of the component Checkpoint Extraction. The manipulation results in path traversal. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-109155.description: A flaw has been found in DeepPavlov up to 1.7.0. This impacts the function untar of the component Model Download Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-109156.description: A vulnerability has been found in SeldonIO MLServer up to 1.6.1. Affected is the function _extract_env of the file mlserver/env.py of the component environment_tarball Handler. Such manipulation leads to path traversal. The attack may be performed from remote. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109157.description: A vulnerability was found in TRENDnet TEW-432BRP 3.10B20. Affected by this vulnerability is the function formTcpipSetup of the file /goform/formTcpipSetup. Performing a manipulation of the argument Name results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor confirms: "As this router was EOL'd in 2011, we have no way of testing if such vulnerability exists. We will notify our customers of a potential vulnerability on this product." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

CVE-2026-109160.description: A vulnerability was determined in PublicCMS up to 5.202608.a. Affected by this issue is the function SafeConfigComponent.getSafeUrl of the file publiccms-core/src/main/java/com/publiccms/logic/component/config/SafeConfigComponent.java of the component pay Endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument returnUrl can lead to open redirect. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109189.description: A vulnerability was detected in fit2cloud MeterSphere up to 3.6.9-lts. The affected element is the function Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.testUrlTimeout of the file backend/parser/api/dataimport/Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.java of the component Swagger3 Parser. Performing a manipulation of the argument swaggerUrl results in server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109190.description: A vulnerability has been found in conductor-oss conductor 3.31.2. This affects the function ListApiToolsTask.start of the file ListApiToolsTask.java of the component API Tool Configuration. The manipulation of the argument specUrl leads to server-side request forgery. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

CVE-2026-109402.description: A vulnerability was found in conductor-oss conductor 3.22.0. Affected is the function MCPService.listTools of the file ai/src/main/java/org/conductoross/conductor/ai/mcp/MCPService.java of the component MCP Service. Performing a manipulation of the argument mcpServer results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

CVE-2026-109832.description: A flaw was found in gnome-remote-desktop as shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux. In the VNC TLS I/O handlers, retryable GnuTLS results (GNUTLS_E_AGAIN and GNUTLS_E_INTERRUPTED) are handled with an unbounded busy loop instead of yielding to the event loop. A remote attacker who can reach an enabled VNC TLS listener can cause the event-loop thread to spin at high CPU with no forward progress, resulting in denial of service.

CVE-2026-63316.description: A SQL injection vulnerability has been identified in Payload CMS. Improper neutralization of input provided by user into "in" and "not_in" query paramethers allows an authenticated attacker to perform SQL Injection attacks. This issue was fixed in version 3.90.0 and 4.0.0-canary.34.

CVE-2026-89279.description: Cross-Site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in AuthTake Technology Inc. Authtake allows Encryption Brute Forcing. This issue affects authtake: from v1.3 before v1.4.

CVE-2026-94410.description: A low privileged remote attacker is able to view a list of roles that should only be accessible to administrators. This results in a low level of confidentiality breach, as no particularly sensitive information is affected.

CVE-2026-109403.description: A vulnerability was determined in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.32.5. Affected by this vulnerability is the function A2AService.getAgentCard of the file ai/src/main/java/org/conductoross/conductor/ai/a2a/A2AService.java of the component Agent Card Fetching. Executing a manipulation of the argument agentUrl can lead to server-side request forgery. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

CVE-2026-109404.description: A vulnerability was identified in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.33.0-rc10. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file AgentController.java of the component Agentspan Agent Runtime. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible.

CVE-2026-109405.description: A security flaw has been discovered in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.33.0-rc10. This affects the function KafkaPublishTask.start of the file kafka/src/main/java/com/netflix/conductor/contribs/tasks/kafka/KafkaPublishTask.java. The manipulation of the argument kafka_request.bootStrapServers results in server-side request forgery. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-109406.description: A weakness has been identified in macrozheng mall up to 1.0.3. This vulnerability affects the function OmsPortalOrderServiceImpl of the file /order/generateOrder of the component mall-portal. This manipulation of the argument coupon_amount/pay_amount causes business logic errors. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor deleted the GitHub issue for this vulnerability without any explanation.

CVE-2026-109407.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in macrozheng mall up to 1.0.3. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /order/generateOrder of the component Coupon Redemption. Such manipulation of the argument couponId leads to race condition. The attack may be performed from remote. The attack requires a high level of complexity. The exploitability is assessed as difficult. The vendor deleted the GitHub issue for this vulnerability without any explanation.

CVE-2026-109833.description: A flaw was found in gnome-remote-desktop as shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux. In the VNC TLS read path, partial consumption of the internal peek buffer incorrectly moves remaining peeked bytes into the caller-supplied buffer instead of compacting the peek buffer. A remote attacker who can reach an enabled VNC TLS listener and trigger a peek/read size mismatch can cause an out-of-bounds write, leading to denial of service.

CVE-2026-109976.description: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afunix-socket-unlock daemon crashes when an AF_UNIX client connects to the data socket without a bound address, due to an integer underflow in the getpeername result handling. This causes a denial of service, preventing LUKS disk decryption from completing during boot.

CVE-2026-65103.description: NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a path traversal vulnerability in the target-side object rename handler, where an unauthenticated remote attacker could cause an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory by submitting a crafted rename destination directly to an AIStore target, resulting in the arbitrary creation or overwrite of a file. CVE-2026-65173.description: NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the token-revocation endpoint where an unauthenticated remote attacker may submit crafted token-revocation lists. A successful exploit may lead to data tampering and denial of service.

CVE-2026-103499.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 and IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, and 9.0 Liberty could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service due to uncontrolled resource consumption.

CVE-2026-107832.description: fastify is a fast and low overhead web framework for Node.js. In versions 5.12.2 through 5.12.5, the routine that lowercases header names declared in a route schema does not lowercase the enum or const header names nested inside a propertyNames subschema. As a result, a header allow-list or deny-list written with canonical (non-lowercase) casing never matches the incoming lowercased header, so a restricted header passes validation and reaches the route handler. An attacker can therefore bypass a case-sensitive header validation rule and smuggle a forbidden header past the schema, affecting the integrity of request handling. The issue is fixed in fastify 5.12.6, and users should upgrade to 5.12.6 or later. There is no workaround other than upgrading, though applications can declare header names in lowercase to avoid the mismatch.

CVE-2026-109409.description: A flaw has been found in HBAI-Ltd Toonflow-app up to 1.1.8. The affected element is the function child_process.exec of the file src/routes/setting/fileManagement/openFolder.ts of the component Open Folder Endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument path can lead to command injection. The attack needs to be launched locally. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor explains: "The report targets ToonFlow version 1.1.8. The current release is 2.0.4, which is the result of a substantial architectural refactor; the code paths referenced in the report do not apply to the current version. The report does not describe a vulnerability in any supported release."

CVE-2026-109410.description: A vulnerability has been found in macrozheng mall 1.0.3 dcaa93b. The impacted element is the function OmsOrderServiceImpl.updateMoneyInfo of the file /order/update/moneyInfo of the component mall-admin/mall-portal. The manipulation leads to incorrect calculation. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor deleted the GitHub issue for this vulnerability without any explanation.

CVE-2026-109519.description: A vulnerability was detected in YouTransfer up to 0.0.7/1.0.6/1.1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file /settings/template of the component Template Rendering. The manipulation results in path traversal. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109520.description: A flaw has been found in Colorful iGameCenter 2.0.0.82. Affected by this vulnerability is the function MmMapIoSpace in the library AMDRyzenMasterDriver.sys of the component Dispatch Handler. This manipulation of the argument SystemBuffer causes privilege defined with unsafe actions. The attack needs to be launched locally. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-109676.description: FreeRDP from 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in smartcard handling that allows attackers to access a freed smartcard handle object after an invalid connect operation. Attackers can trigger an invalid smartcard connect operation to cause reuse of the freed handle, leading to memory corruption or crashes.

CVE-2026-109677.description: FreeRDP from 2.0.0-beta1 before 3.28.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in smartcard_LocateCardsByATRA_Call because the ATR pattern cbAtr byte count is not capped. Malicious RDP servers can send crafted ATR mask arrays to use query timing as an oracle, leaking heap memory bit-by-bit to defeat ASLR and aid RCE exploits.

CVE-2026-109678.description: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0, when built with verbose WinPR assertions and using smartcard emulation, has a reachable assertion: the emulated SCardStatusA passes a NULL reader-name destination to scard_copy_strings. A malicious RDP server can send an SCardStatusA request with fmszReaderNamesIsNULL=1 to abort a connecting client.

CVE-2026-109679.description: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta4 before 3.32.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference in arm_handle_request_ok when an ARM endpoint returns an empty HTTP 200 body. Attackers controlling the configured ARM gateway can return a zero-length body to pass NULL to strnlen and crash the connecting client.

CVE-2026-109680.description: FreeRDP 3.18.0 before 3.32.0 has a heap-based out-of-bounds write in freerdp_interruptible_get_line, which shrinks the buffer to 32 bytes while keeping a pre-filled suggested username's length as its write offset. A malicious or compromised ARM routing service can return a long redirectedUsername that reaches the CLI credential prompt, crashing the client when the user types input.

CVE-2026-109938.description: Positive mapped-video coordinates overflow and abort FreeRDP clients A malicious or compromised RDP server can terminate a FreeRDP client after the user connects with video redirection enabled.

CVE-2026-109939.description: FreeRDP 3.27.1 before 3.32.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference in update_read_cache_bitmap_v3_order() in libfreerdp/core/orders.c, which accesses the client bitmap cache when the CBR3_DO_NOT_CACHE flag is set, even though the cache is not yet initialized before Demand Active. A malicious or compromised RDP server can send a Cache Bitmap V3 order during connection setup to crash a connecting client that has enabled the non-default Bitmap Cache V3 feature (/cache:codec:<rfx|nsc|jpeg>).

CVE-2026-109940.description: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0 on Unix builds with PKCS#11 support has a stack-based buffer overflow in wprintKeyName() in WinPR's NCrypt PKCS#11 provider. It hex-encodes a key's CKA_ID, which can be up to 64 bytes, into a fixed 128-byte stack buffer. An attacker supplying a malicious PKCS#11 token or module whose key and matching certificate use a 55- to 64-byte CKA_ID can overflow the client's stack during key enumeration, causing a crash.

CVE-2026-109941.description: FreeRDP from 2.3.0 before 3.32.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in http_chuncked_read that allows malicious RD Gateways to hang clients by sending incomplete chunked responses. Attackers can send a partial chunk-size line or footer followed by a clean TLS shutdown, causing zero-byte reads to loop forever and freeze the client decoder thread.

CVE-2026-109942.description: FreeRDP 2.3.0 before 3.32.0 dereferences a NULL stream in rdg_process_close_packet in libfreerdp/core/gateway/rdg.c because rdg_process_control_packet accepts a header-only PKT_TYPE_CLOSE_CHANNEL packet and passes the null payload without a check. A malicious or compromised RD Gateway can send an eight-byte CLOSE_CHANNEL header to crash a connecting FreeRDP client.

CVE-2026-109943.description: FreeRDP 3.29.0 before 3.32.0 contains a double free in the client's async-update message proxy, which shallow-copies the parser-owned PolygonSC or PolygonCB points array when numPoints is zero, so both the queue consumer and parser cleanup free it. A malicious RDP server can send a point-bearing polygon order followed by a zero-point order to crash a client with +async-update enabled.

CVE-2026-109944.description: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 does not remove card handles when Emulate_SCardReleaseContext releases a smartcard-emulation context, so Emulate_SCardTransmit later looks up the deleted parent context and reaches a terminating WINPR_ASSERT. A malicious RDP server can crash a connecting client with smartcard emulation and redirection enabled by releasing a context, establishing another, and issuing SCardTransmit with the stale card handle.

CVE-2026-109945.description: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in smartcard emulation when SCARD_IOCTL_DISCONNECT and SCARD_IOCTL_TRANSMIT operate concurrently on one card handle. A malicious RDP server can overlap these IRPs through separate context workers to free and reuse the SCardHandle, causing client-process heap corruption and termination.

CVE-2026-109946.description: FreeRDP 3.11.0 before 3.32.0 does not validate that AVC444 and AVC444v2 region widths are even before YUV444 conversion, so an odd width reaches an assertion and aborts the client. A malicious or compromised RDP server can terminate a connected FreeRDP client after RDPGFX AVC444 negotiation by sending an in-bounds region rectangle with an odd width.

CVE-2026-109947.description: FreeRDP from 3.20.1 before 3.32.0 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability that allows malicious RDP servers to exhaust client memory via oversized drive redirection read requests. Attackers can send IRP_MJ_READ with Length 0xffffffff, causing roughly 4 GiB of zeroed allocation on 64-bit builds or an under-reserved buffer on 32-bit builds.

CVE-2026-109948.description: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in smartcard_Transmit_Call that allows malicious RDP servers to read client memory. Servers can send SCardTransmit requests with an invalid card handle and nonzero receive length, causing smartcard_pack_transmit_return to serialize up to 66,560 uninitialized heap bytes.

CVE-2026-109949.description: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts in its virtual smartcard GIDS implementation, which stores the PIN retry counter per-handle. A malicious RDP server can exhaust the counter with VERIFY APDUs, then request a new SCardConnect to reset attempts, enabling unbounded online brute-forcing of the configured smartcard PIN.

CVE-2026-109950.description: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows a malicious RD Gateway to crash clients by sending mismatched message lengths. Attackers controlling the gateway can set MsgBytes far larger than the NDR string ActualCount in consent or service messages, causing UTF-8 conversion to read past the stream allocation and disrupt client availability.

CVE-2026-109951.description: FreeRDP 3.17.1 before 3.32.0 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in DynvcTrackerHandleCreateBack of the freerdp-proxy DRDYNVC channel handler that allows malicious backend RDP servers to read heap memory out of bounds. Attackers can send a CREATE_REQUEST_PDU whose channel name lacks a NUL byte, causing an unbounded snprintf read that leaks memory into proxy logs or crashes the process.

CVE-2026-109952.description: The FreeRDP client 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 does not check a server-selected PROTOCOL_RDSTLS or PROTOCOL_HYBRID_EX against its enabled protocol set in nego_process_negotiation_response(), allowing a security protocol downgrade. A malicious server or man-in-the-middle can select RDSTLS to override /sec:nla pinning, complete authentication with an all-zero cookie, and receive the user's cleartext password in the Client Info PDU.

CVE-2026-109953.description: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability where the /restricted-admin option fails to suppress CredSSP credential delegation, sending the cleartext password to the RDP server. A compromised or man-in-the-middle destination host can decode TSPasswordCreds and the Client Info PDU to obtain reusable administrative domain, username, and password values.

CVE-2026-109954.description: Parse Server 5.4.0 before 8.6.96 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.2-alpha.5 shares transactional batch state across concurrent requests, letting any client's transactional batch request interfere with other clients' database writes. On PostgreSQL or MongoDB replica sets and sharded clusters, other clients' acknowledged writes are rolled back if the batch fails, and PostgreSQL transactions can remain open indefinitely, causing subsequent writes to fail.

CVE-2026-109955.description: Hono from 4.12.4 before 4.13.11 contains a middleware bypass vulnerability in serveStatic that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip prefix middleware by exploiting double path decoding. Attackers can send malformed percent-encoded paths that the router matches in encoded form, reaching static files without authentication checks running.

CVE-2026-109956.description: NLTK through 3.10.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in WekaClassifier that allows attackers to bypass nltk.pathsec containment by supplying unvalidated model paths. Attackers controlling the model_filename or model argument can make the weka JVM write files via -d or probe files via -l outside allowed data roots.

CVE-2026-109957.description: EspoCRM before 10.0.7 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Import scope access to read other users' attachments by supplying a foreign attachmentId to the Import endpoint. Attackers can create an Import record referencing a known attachment ID, then call the error export endpoint to copy source rows into a downloadable CSV they own.

CVE-2026-109958.description: EspoCRM 4.0.0 before 10.0.7 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read restricted emailAddress values via the address-book search API. Users with record access can query address-book search to obtain email addresses even when Roles restrict the emailAddress field.

CVE-2026-109959.description: EspoCRM 4.0.0 before 10.0.7 contains an access control vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read audited field values restricted by field-level security by fetching individual stream notes. Users with stream access to a parent record can request GET /Note/{id}, which skips the NoteAccessControl filter, and recover data.attributes.was and became values of restricted fields.

CVE-2026-109960.description: Froxlor 2.0.0 before 2.3.14 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to inject HTML and JavaScript by setting a malicious theme value via customer_index.php. Script executes when an administrator views the customer overview with the Theme column enabled, letting attackers abuse the CSRF token to create administrator accounts or change server settings.

CVE-2026-109961.description: Froxlor 0.10.0 before 2.3.14 contains a newline injection vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to inject arbitrary entries into the root-owned NSS group database via the unvalidated additional_members parameter of the Ftps.add API. Attackers can embed newline characters that the REBUILD_NSSUSERS cron writes unsanitized into /var/lib/extrausers/group, creating privileged group entries for local privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-109962.description: Froxlor 0.10.0 before 2.3.14 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows reseller accounts to read full-admin-only MySQL server and cronjob configuration via API read commands. Resellers can call MysqlServer.listing, MysqlServer.get, or Cronjobs.listing through api.php to obtain management usernames, hosts, ports, TLS settings, and cron metadata.

CVE-2026-109963.description: Froxlor before 2.3.14 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the email template editor (admin_templates.php) because the mail body is fetched by mailbodyid without an adminid ownership check. Authenticated reseller admins can pair their own subjectid with sequential foreign mailbodyid values in edit requests to read other admins' email templates, including the full administrator's.

CVE-2026-109964.description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 contains a heap buffer underwrite vulnerability in DecodeImage() in coders/pict.c on 32-bit builds due to pointer arithmetic overflow. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with maximized row, column and bytes-per-line values to bypass bounds checks and write up to 128 controlled bytes below the heap buffer, causing crashes or code execution.

CVE-2026-109965.description: Serena before 2.0.0 contains an improper link resolution vulnerability that allows attackers to access files outside the project root by committing symlinks inside a repository. Project.is_path_in_project() normalizes paths lexically without resolving symlinks, so file tools like read_file and create_text_file can read or overwrite files such as SSH keys or cloud credentials.

CVE-2026-109966.description: yt-dlp-web-ui through 4.0.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject yt-dlp options by supplying a dash-prefixed url parameter to the Service.Formats JSON-RPC method. Attackers can send values like --load-info-json via /rpc/http or /rpc/ws to make yt-dlp load attacker-chosen JSON files from the server filesystem, with contents reflected in responses.

CVE-2026-109967.description: yt-dlp-web-ui through 4.0.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the Service.Formats JSON-RPC method that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to crash the server. Attackers can send a single request with a url value like --version, causing invalid yt-dlp JSON output and an unrecovered panic that terminates the process.

CVE-2026-74030.description: Wazuh from 3.9.0 before 4.14.8 contains an uncontrolled YAML alias expansion vulnerability in yaml2json_node that allows a manager-controlled policy to exhaust agent memory. Attackers controlling the manager can push a small SCA policy with nested aliases via merged.mg to OOM-kill wazuh-modulesd on every agent in a group.

CVE-2026-74031.description: Wazuh from 4.1.1 before 4.14.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the delete_rule_file and delete_decoder_file helpers that allows malicious cluster workers to delete arbitrary files via an unvalidated filename parameter. Attackers holding the cluster key can invoke these helpers through DistributedAPI with traversal sequences to delete ossec.conf, client.keys, or rules as the wazuh user.

CVE-2026-74032.description: Wazuh from 4.0.0 before 4.14.8 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read the RBAC catalog by querying unprotected security endpoints. Attackers can request GET /security/actions and /security/resources, which omit the caller's RBAC policies, to map privileged actions and endpoints for privilege escalation planning.

CVE-2026-74033.description: Wazuh from 4.1.1 before 4.14.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the get_lists() and delete_list_file() CDB list handlers that allows compromised cluster workers to read or delete master files. Attackers can send traversal or absolute-path filenames through the internal cluster RPC path, bypassing REST validation and RBAC to delete files like rbac.db.

CVE-2026-74034.description: Wazuh from 4.1.0 before 4.14.8 contains a missing origin check in wm_agent_upgrade that allows enrolled agents to issue upgrade_custom commands with attacker-controlled file_path. Attackers can inject an upgrade_custom message over the agent channel to read arbitrary files as root, exfiltrating /etc/shadow and client.keys.

CVE-2026-74035.description: Wazuh versions from 4.6.0 before 4.14.8 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability where security.update_user places the reserved user guard and password policy inside a falsy truthiness check. A delegated user administrator can send an empty password to the user update endpoint, bypassing the reserved user guard to take over the wazuh superuser account and authenticate with empty credentials.

CVE-2026-74036.description: Wazuh from 4.3.0 before 4.14.8 contains a remote code execution vulnerability where SCA policy trust is determined by file path rather than configuration source. Attackers controlling a manager can write unsigned policy files to var/incoming via the upgrade channel and reference them to execute command checks as root on agents.

CVE-2026-74037.description: Wazuh 4.0.0 before 4.14.8 fails to invalidate issued tokens for run_as users with zero static roles, because check_token never consults the blacklist. Attackers with revoked administrator grants can continue authenticating and self-link the administrator role to permanently retain privileged access.

CVE-2026-74040.description: Wazuh versions from 3.9.0 before 4.14.8 contain an arbitrary file overwrite vulnerability in MasterHandler.process_files_from_worker allowing a cluster worker to overwrite protected master files. Attackers controlling a worker can use a trailing-slash basename bypass and missing extra_valid enforcement to overwrite ossec.conf and agent.conf, achieving root remote code execution across the manager and every agent.

CVE-2026-74041.description: Wazuh 4.14.3 before 4.14.8 contains a case-sensitivity mismatch between the ossec.conf validator and wazuh-logcollector that bypasses remote-command validation. Authenticated users with manager:update_config can inject an uppercase LOG_FORMAT command localfile that the collector runs as root on reload.

CVE-2026-74043.description: Wazuh from 4.1.1 before 4.14.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in upload_list_file, upload_rule_file, and upload_decoder_file that allows malicious cluster workers to write files at arbitrary paths. Attackers holding the cluster key can send DistributedAPI requests with ../ sequences in filename, bypassing REST controller validation, to write files as the wazuh user.

CVE-2026-74045.description: Wazuh from 3.12.0 before 4.14.8 contains a heap buffer overflow in fim_generate_alert() where full_log is sized from input but written bounded by OS_MAXSTR. An enrolled agent can send a crafted FIM syscheck event to corrupt manager heap memory and deterministically crash wazuh-analysisd, causing a fleet-wide detection outage.

CVE-2026-74047.description: Wazuh from 4.0.0 before 4.14.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged users with agent:read to retrieve the plaintext authd.pass enrollment password via the unmasked agent configuration endpoint. Attackers holding the default readonly role can request the auth component configuration for pseudo-agent ID 000 to obtain the secret and enroll rogue agents against the manager.

CVE-2026-77361.description: obsidian-tc is a governed, agent-ready Model Context Protocol server for Obsidian vaults. Prior to 1.3.1, read access-control list (ACL) checks use a lexical vault-relative path while containment checks use the resolved path. An in-vault symlink under an allowed glob that resolves into a denied folder can therefore bypass the read ACL and expose files in the denied folder. Exploitation requires an out-of-band-planted symlink and does not permit an escape from the vault root. Version 1.3.1 fixes the vulnerability by applying ACL checks to the resolved vault-relative path.

CVE-2026-77362.description: obsidian-tc is a governed, agent-ready Model Context Protocol server for Obsidian vaults. Prior to 1.3.1, bridge tools do not consistently apply the read access-control list (ACL) to every returned field. The tasks_filter tool exposes group counts derived from denied notes, makemd_query passes unfiltered sibling result fields through, and list_templates exposes template paths and parsed user-function bodies without a read-whitelist check. An authenticated caller can consequently infer or read data from notes outside the caller's read ACL. Version 1.3.1 fixes the vulnerability by filtering path-attributable fields and applying the read whitelist to list_templates.

CVE-2026-93346.description: Wazuh from 4.0.0 before 4.14.8 contains a race condition in API login throttling that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass max_login_attempts by sending concurrent requests. Attackers can fire concurrent login bursts to the authenticate and run_as endpoints, each passing the block check before failures are counted, enabling unlimited password guessing.

CVE-2026-93347.description: Wazuh from 4.1.1 before 4.14.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the get_list_file helper that allows malicious cluster workers to read arbitrary files via unvalidated filename values. Attackers holding the cluster key can send DistributedAPI requests with traversal filenames to read client.keys, ossec.conf with the cluster key, and other wazuh-readable files.

CVE-2026-93907.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, and 9.0 could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication by exploiting a flaw in the CSIv2 inbound propagation handler.

CVE-2026-95680.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, and 9.0 could allow an authenticated attacker to bypass authorization leading to administrative impersonation across the cell.

bbc47380bfad3c3436ff5880.title_ko: 앤트로픽, 차세대 AI 모델 실전 라우팅 테스트 착수
bbc47380bfad3c3436ff5880.summary_ko: 앤트로픽이 플래그십 모델 환경에서 기존 트래픽의 일부를 미공개 고성능 모델로 우회시키는 실전 라우팅 테스트를 진행 중인 정황이 포착되었다. 테스터들은 향상된 멀티모달 및 코딩 성능을 보이는 미공개 모델의 결과물을 공유하며 높은 기대감을 드러내고 있다.

8f6b757e52897952207c96b7.title_ko: Claude Code 세션 충돌 방지 도구 소개
8f6b757e52897952207c96b7.summary_ko: 깃 워크트리별로 여러 개의 Claude Code 세션을 동시에 실행할 때 발생하는 프로세스, 포트, 메모리 충돌 문제를 해결하기 위한 도구 및 설정 내용이다. 한 에이전트의 작업 정리로 인해 다른 세션의 개발 서버가 종료되는 현상을 막는 방법을 다룬다.

b1105290951bd9505d0ed9f4.title_ko: AI 스타트업 타입세이프의 의사결정 모델 '제브' 표절 논란
b1105290951bd9505d0ed9f4.summary_ko: AI 스타트업 타입세이프가 공개한 의사결정 모델 '제브'가 1년 전 발표된 기존 연구와 유사하다는 표절 논란이 제기되었다. 제브는 긴 텍스트 생성 대신 입력 데이터와 질문을 바탕으로 선택지의 확률을 계산하여 속도를 높이고 환각 문제를 줄인 모델이다.

e26e0bc0696048ade85f6baa.title_ko: 프랑스 대형마트 냉장고를 해킹해 온도를 높인 사이버 공격 발생
e26e0bc0696048ade85f6baa.summary_ko: 공격자들이 덴마크 댄포스의 냉동 제어기를 원격으로 탈취해 프랑스 전역 수백 개 대형마트의 냉장고와 냉동고 온도를 섭씨 50도까지 높이는 사건이 발생했다. 프랑스 보안 기관 CERT-FR은 취약한 구형 제어기의 인터넷 연결 해제와 접근 필터링을 긴급 권고했다.

4f0e1b4f2d00b6374f5a60df.title_ko: 파이어폭스에서 대용량 파일 다운로드 재개 설정 방법
4f0e1b4f2d00b6374f5a60df.summary_ko: 파이어폭스의 about:config 설정을 변경하여 대용량 다운로드를 재개할 수 있도록 만드는 실험적 방법이다. network.http.response.timeout 값을 조정하여 안정성을 높이는 내용을 담고 있다.

14a3e7f72e279c939e4984da.title_ko: 인텔, 최대 480GB LPDDR5X 탑재 D270 GPU AI 가속기 공개
14a3e7f72e279c939e4984da.summary_ko: 인텔의 GPU D270은 대규모 학습보다는 프로덕션 AI 추론과 에이전트 워크로드에 최적화된 데이터센터용 가속기다. 카드당 최대 480GB의 LPDDR5X 메모리를 탑재해 긴 컨텍스트와 KV 캐시를 효율적으로 처리한다.

2adb8482915b0f2768b47051.title_ko: MarkLogic 서버 취약점 31건 공개... 관리자 권한 탈취 가능
2adb8482915b0f2768b47051.summary_ko: 프로그레스 소프트웨어의 MarkLogic 데이터베이스에서 서버 관리자 권한을 획득할 수 있는 치명적인 취약점을 포함해 31개의 보안 결함이 새롭게 공개되었습니다. 일부 권한을 가진 계정이 관리자 제어권을 장악하거나 서버 측 코드를 실행할 수 있는 위험이 있어, 사용자는 최신 버전인 11.3.7 또는 12.1.0으로 업그레이드해야 합니다.

ff00212935a41d14accc0029.title_ko: 깃랩, 인증 없는 서버 코드 실행 가능한 최고 심각도 취약점 패치
ff00212935a41d14accc0029.summary_ko: 깃랩이 커뮤니티 및 엔터프라이즈 에디션에서 인증되지 않은 사용자가 임의의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 CVSS 10.0 만점의 취약점(CVE-2026-97229)을 수정했습니다. CI/CD 설정 내 정규표현식 검증 미흡으로 발생한 정수 오버플로 문제이며, 깃랩은 보안 패치가 포함된 버전을 배포하고 사용자들의 즉각적인 업데이트를 권고했습니다.

48e9adf6e27129f7a7c8ec60.title_ko: AI 모델이 임의의 능력을 숨길 수 있음을 이론적으로 증명
48e9adf6e27129f7a7c8ec60.summary_ko: 모델 가중치에 암호화된 신경망을 내장하고 특정 비밀 트리거가 입력될 때만 복호화하여 실행하는 백도어 구성을 통해, 적대적 조건에서 숨겨진 능력을 평가로 유도할 수 없다는 기존 가정이 성립하지 않음이 이론적으로 증명되었습니다. 이는 디지털 로커와 명시된 암호학적 가정을 기반으로 AI 모델의 안전성 검증 한계를 보여줍니다.

37f8d64044d65ea1336cfb9e.title_ko: 새마을금고중앙회, 공제회원 정보 유출 공식 사과 및 전액 보상 약속
37f8d64044d65ea1336cfb9e.summary_ko: 새마을금고중앙회가 공제회원 개인신용정보 유출 사고에 대해 공식 사과하고 피해 발생 시 전액 보상 방침을 밝혔습니다. 이번 사고로 고객번호와 이름, 암호화된 주민등록번호 등이 유출되었으며, 중앙회는 공격자 IP 차단 및 홈페이지 취약점 점검을 완료하고 피해 접수를 진행하고 있습니다.

e235fa36251b4f6d5c454759.title_ko: 오픈AI, 'GPT-6.1 솔' 컨텍스트 길이 50만 토큰으로 확대
e235fa36251b4f6d5c454759.summary_ko: 오픈AI가 코덱스와 챗GPT 워크에서 사용되는 'GPT-6.1 솔'의 기본 컨텍스트 길이를 기존 27만 2000 토큰에서 50만 토큰으로 대폭 상향했습니다. 이는 80% 늘어난 규모로, 장시간 작업에서 맥락 압축 빈도를 줄이고 대규모 코드베이스나 복잡한 작업의 연속성과 정확성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

b72617d84647631f083dc496.title_ko: 시놀로지 솔루션 데이 2026 개최... AI 시대 데이터 관리 전략 공개
b72617d84647631f083dc496.summary_ko: 시놀로지가 '시놀로지 솔루션 데이 2026'을 개최하고 AI 시대의 근간이 되는 데이터 가치 재조명과 안전한 관리 전략을 공개했습니다. 기업이 데이터 통제권을 지키면서 AI를 안전하게 활용할 수 있도록 돕는 차세대 엔터프라이즈 스토리지와 통합 백업 솔루션 등이 소개되었습니다.

ac20bf3821211a8dc8176420.title_ko: MS, 코드로 영상 속 물리법칙 정밀 제어하는 '코드 비디오 모델' 공개
ac20bf3821211a8dc8176420.summary_ko: 마이크로소프트가 실행 가능한 코드를 활용해 영상의 장면 구성, 객체 움직임, 카메라 경로 등을 정밀 제어하는 '코드 비디오 모델'을 공개했다. 이 모델은 코딩 에이전트로 미리보기 영상을 만든 뒤 비디오 생성 모델과 결합해 최종 영상을 생성하며, 허깅페이스와 깃허브를 통해 공개됐다.

850e85a893a0bb05584a92e4.title_ko: 텍스트·이미지 등 다중 모달 처리하는 오픈소스 의사결정 모델 '디시전 3.0' 공개
850e85a893a0bb05584a92e4.summary_ko: vLLM 시맨틱 라우터 개발팀이 텍스트, JSON뿐만 아니라 이미지까지 직접 분석할 수 있는 멀티모달 의사결정 모델 '디시전 3.0'을 오픈소스로 공개했다. 이 모델은 비전 인코더를 내장해 별도의 비전 모델 거치는 단계를 줄이고, 질문에 대한 선택지별 확률값을 반환해 AI 에이전트의 판단과 라우팅을 간소화한다.

b940c09f31d9264ca31a01e4.title_ko: AI로 멜론 수확량 높이는 핵심 유전자 변이를 수분 만에 발굴
b940c09f31d9264ca31a01e4.summary_ko: AI 연구소 리빙 모델스가 식물 DNA 특화 모델 '보타닉-1'과 범용 언어모델을 결합해 수천 개 후보 변이 중 수확량에 영향을 주는 핵심 유전자 변이를 4분 만에 찾아냈다. 이번 연구는 범용 AI와 전문 유전체 모델의 결합을 통해 농작물 품종 개량 연구를 가속화할 수 있음을 보여준다.

ff00212935a41d14accc0029.title_original: GitLab Patches CVSS 10.0 Flaw That Could Let Unauthenticated Users Run Server Code
ff00212935a41d14accc0029.title_ko: 깃랩, 인증 없는 서버 코드 실행 가능한 최고 심각도 취약점 패치
ff00212935a41d14accc0029.summary_ko: 깃랩이 커뮤니티 및 엔터프라이즈 에디션에서 인증되지 않은 사용자가 임의의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 CVSS 10.0 만점의 취약점(CVE-2026-97229)을 수정했습니다. CI/CD 설정 내 정규표현식 검증 미흡으로 발생한 정수 오버플로 문제이며, 깃랩은 보안 패치가 포함된 버전을 배포하고 사용자들의 즉각적인 업데이트를 권고했습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 깃랩에서 미인증 원격 코드 실행이 가능한 CVSS 10.0 취약점이 긴급 패치됐다.

81d5f9d2f518e33b2c41a8b4.title_original: 국내 해운·철강사 12곳에 랜섬웨어 공격 주장...“19일까지 협상 안 하면 데이터 공개” 협박

ce5fe07add9f4c52fa876559.title_ko: 오픈AI 회의실에 도청장치 설치한 사우디 국적 직원 체포
ce5fe07add9f4c52fa876559.summary_ko: 미국 오픈AI의 사내 임원용 회의실에 비밀리에 녹음장치를 설치한 사우디아라비아 국적의 엔지니어가 불법 통신 감청 시도 혐의로 FBI에 체포됐다. 해당 직원은 챗봇에 도청기 제작 및 은닉 방법 등을 질의한 정황이 포착됐다. 오픈AI는 자체 AI 모델을 활용해 장치의 출처를 분석한 뒤 당국에 신고했으며, 현재까지 핵심 소스코드나 고객 데이터 유출 정황은 없는 것으로 전해졌다.

curation.reason_ko: 오픈AI 사내 회의실에 도청기를 설치하려던 사우디 국적 엔지니어가 FBI에 체포됐다.

6ceef368972ea4e5864c19be.title_ko: Hello World AI 해커톤 참가자 모집
6ceef368972ea4e5864c19be.summary_ko: 만 14세 이상 누구나 참가할 수 있는 Hello World AI 해커톤이 개최된다. 접수 기간은 10월 30일까지이며, 대회는 10월 31일에 서울 마포 또는 선릉에서 진행된다.

curation.reason_ko: 만 14세 이상 누구나 참여 가능한 Hello World AI 해커톤 모집이 시작됐다.

e26e0bc0696048ade85f6baa.title_original: Attackers Heat French Supermarket Fridges Up to 50°C by Hijacking Danfoss Controllers
e26e0bc0696048ade85f6baa.title_ko: 프랑스 대형마트 냉장고를 해킹해 온도를 높인 사이버 공격 발생
e26e0bc0696048ade85f6baa.summary_ko: 공격자들이 덴마크 댄포스의 냉동 제어기를 원격으로 탈취해 프랑스 전역 수백 개 대형마트의 냉장고와 냉동고 온도를 섭씨 50도까지 높이는 사건이 발생했다. 프랑스 보안 기관 CERT-FR은 취약한 구형 제어기의 인터넷 연결 해제와 접근 필터링을 긴급 권고했다.

curation.reason_ko: 냉동 제어기 해킹으로 프랑스 대형마트 설비가 마비되는 대규모 물리적 피해가 발생했다.

d0ef4a564c9577fcd99820e2.title_ko: 금융사 16곳에서 해킹 및 개인정보 유출 발생… 금융당국, AI 기반 보안체계 구축 추진
d0ef4a564c9577fcd99820e2.summary_ko: 신한은행과 KB국민은행 등 금융회사 16곳에서 침해사고가 발생해 약 10만 건의 개인정보가 유출된 것으로 확인되었다. 금융당국의 긴급 점검 결과 다수의 금융사에서 최신 보안패치 미적용 등 기본적인 보안관리 부실이 드러났다. 이에 금융당국은 AI 기반의 공동 보안관제 체계를 구축하고 관련 제도를 개선할 방침이다.

curation.reason_ko: 국내 주요 금융사 16곳 침해로 10만건 유출 및 보안 미흡이 적발됐다.

5e26a7e4df572f77064c021b.title_ko: Echo: 대규모 언어 모델 학습 및 추론을 위한 오차 보상형 4비트 텐서 병렬 통신 기법
5e26a7e4df572f77064c021b.summary_ko: 대규모 언어 모델의 텐서 병렬 통신 비용을 줄이기 위해 누적 오차를 제어하는 4비트 all-reduce 기법인 Echo가 제안되었다. 이 기법은 4비트로 데이터를 전송하고 고정밀도로 합산하여 양자화 오차가 누적되지 않도록 제어한다. 추가적인 특수 하드웨어 없이도 기존 16비트 방식에 비해 통신 속도를 크게 개선하고 모델 정확도를 유지하는 것으로 나타났다.

curation.reason_ko: LLM 병렬 통신에서 오차 누적을 제어하며 4비트 통신을 구현하는 기술이 제안됐다.

hot.reason_ko: 주요 시중은행 포함 16곳에서 10만 건의 정보가 유출되어 국내 금융권 영향이 큽니다.
국내 항만·해운 및 철강사 12곳을 노린 신생 랜섬웨어 공격 위협으로 긴급 대응이 필요합니다.
인증 없이 원격 코드 실행이 가능한 CVSS 10.0의 치명적 결함으로 즉각 패치가 요구됩니다.
실제 악용 중인 원격 접근 게이트웨이 인증 우회 제로데이 취약점이 확인되어 긴급합니다.
공제회원 개인신용정보 유출 사고에 대한 공식 사과와 보상 발표로 이용자 주의가 필요합니다.
악용된 제로데이를 포함해 대규모 결함을 해결한 MS 정기 패치로 시스템 점검이 요구됩니다.
오픈AI 사내 회의실에 도청기를 설치한 직원이 체포되며 내부자 위협 실태가 드러났습니다.
AI 모델이 웹 취약점을 자율 악용하는 위험 행동이 포착되어 인터넷 접속이 차단되었습니다.
타 사용자 저장소에 이미지를 푸시할 수 있었던 중대한 도커 허브 권한 허점이 수정되었습니다.
글로벌 대표 생성형 AI 스타트업이 규제와 운영난으로 자발적 파산 절차에 돌입했습니다.

warnings: 1개 수집원이 응답하지 않거나 수집을 제한했습니다. 수집 상태를 확인하세요.

CVE-2026-104935.description: Authentication bypass by spoofing in ICS before version 25.1.3.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. This does not impact ICS version 22.7R2.14 or prior.

kev.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev.vulnerability_name: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability

CVE-2026-104935.summary_ko: 25.1.3.0 버전 미만의 ICS에서 스푸핑을 통한 인증 우회 취약점이 존재하여, 원격의 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Ivanti Connect Secure의 인증 우회 취약점으로 CISA KEV에 등재되어 실제 악용이 확인됨.

CVE-2026-103849.description: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.
CVE-2026-103849.summary_ko: Adobe Commerce는 템플릿 엔진에서 사용되는 특수 요소의 부적절한 무력화 취약점의 영향을 받아, 임의 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Adobe Commerce에서 무인증 원격 코드 실행이 가능한 치명적 취약점(CVSS 10.0)이다.

CVE-2026-94603.description: Podman is a tool for managing OCI containers and pods. From 4.4.0 until 5.8.8 and 6.1.3, podman run treats an image carrying the io.podman.annotations.checkpoint.runtime.name annotation as a checkpoint and silently ignores user-supplied container creation restrictions such as --cap-drop=ALL, allowing image-controlled checkpoint state to select weaker sandbox settings and capabilities. Rootless containers are not affected because checkpoint and restore are unavailable in that mode. This issue is fixed in versions 5.8.8 and 6.1.3.
CVE-2026-94603.summary_ko: Podman이 특정 체크포인트 어노테이션이 포함된 이미지를 처리할 때 사용자 제공 컨테이너 생성 제한을 무시하여 약한 샌드박스 설정과 기능을 선택할 수 있게 합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Podman의 체크포인트 어노테이션 처리 결함으로 샌드박스 제한이 우회되는 치명적 취약점이다.

CVE-2026-110130.description: Dockhand before 1.0.45 contains an authentication bypass in which the global auth hook skips authentication for any path ending in a static-asset extension such as .js, including /api/* routes, and the user-mutation handlers fail open for unauthenticated callers. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send a PUT request to /api/users/<id>.js to reset the admin's or any user's password and take over the account.
CVE-2026-110130.summary_ko: 1.0.45 버전 미만의 Dockhand는 글로벌 인증 훅이 정적 자산 확장자로 끝나는 경로의 인증을 건너뛰고 사용자 변경 핸들러가 개방되어 있어 공격자가 관리자 비밀번호를 재설정할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 정적 자산 확장자 검사 결함으로 무인증 관리자 계정 탈취가 가능한 최고 심각도 취약점이다.

CVE-2026-77459.description: Argo CD is a declarative, GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes. From 2.10.0 until 3.3.15, 3.4.10, 3.5.4, and 3.6.0-rc2, Argo CD creates PostDelete resource hooks without applying the AppProject destination and resource authorization checks used during ordinary synchronization. The omitted checks include cluster-scoped and namespaced resource allow/deny lists. A user who can write to an Application's Git repository can commit a delete hook targeting a forbidden namespace, server, group, kind, or resource name, and deletion of the Application causes the application-controller to create that resource with its destination-cluster credentials. The reachable impact is bounded by the controller's cluster access but can include cluster-scoped resources, disallowed namespaces, persistent hook objects, and secondary objects created by a hook Job. PreSync, Sync, PostSync, and SyncFail hooks continue to use the normal project checks. This issue is fixed in versions 3.3.15, 3.4.10, 3.5.4, and 3.6.0-rc2.
CVE-2026-77459.summary_ko: Argo CD에서 PostDelete 리소스 훅 생성 시 AppProject 대상 및 리소스 권한 부여 검사를 누락하여 애플리케이션 삭제 시 제한된 네임스페이스나 클러스터 리소스를 생성할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Argo CD에서 리소스 검사 누락으로 금지된 네임스페이스나 클러스터 리소스 생성이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-105445.description: An Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Docker Hub's account-to-organization conversion feature allowed an authenticated attacker to reassign a personal access token (PAT) they controlled to another Docker Hub user without rotating or revoking the token secret. The unchanged PAT then authenticated to the registry as the recipient and could pull, push, or delete images, within its scopes, in repositories accessible to that user, including organization repositories.
CVE-2026-105445.summary_ko: Docker Hub의 계정-조직 전환 기능에서 잘못된 권한 할당 취약점이 발생하여, 인증된 공격자가 토큰 비밀을 변경하지 않고도 제어하던 개인용 액세스 토큰을 다른 사용자에게 재할당할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Docker Hub 조직 전환 기능 결함으로 개인 액세스 토큰이 재할당되어 무단 접근이 발생할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-70024.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Internet Information Services allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-70024.summary_ko: Windows 인터넷 정보 서비스(IIS)의 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows IIS에서 원격의 인증되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-100202.description: Use after free in Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-100202.summary_ko: Windows 메시지 큐 큐 관리자의 UAF(Use After Free) 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows MSMQ Queue Manager의 UAF 취약점으로 네트워크를 통한 원격 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-96219.description: Out-of-bounds write in Windows Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-96219.summary_ko: Windows 로컬 보안 권한 하위 시스템 서비스(LSASS)의 범위를 벗어난 쓰기 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows LSASS의 메모리 손상 결함으로 인증되지 않은 원격 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-96113.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-96113.summary_ko: DNS 서버의 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows DNS 서버의 버퍼 오버플로우로 인증되지 않은 원격 코드 실행 위험이 존재한다.

CVE-2026-85792.description: Remote Code Execution in Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) allows attacker to gain an unauthorized access to victim's machine
CVE-2026-85792.summary_ko: Windows 라우팅 및 원격 액세스 서비스(RRAS)의 원격 코드 실행 취약점으로 인해 공격자가 피해자 시스템에 대한 무단 접근 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows RRAS의 UAF 결함으로 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 피해자 시스템을 장악할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-106173.description: A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0 may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.
CVE-2026-106173.summary_ko: Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0의 경로 순회 취약점으로 인해 공격자가 특수 제작된 패킷을 통해 권한 없는 코드나 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Fortinet FortiSIEM에서 조작된 패킷을 통해 원격 코드 및 명령 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-103928.description: Metabase is an open source business intelligence and analytics platform. From 1.55.0 until 1.58.16, 1.59.13, 1.60.9, and 1.61.4, native queries and actions against an H2 data source are passed through without restricting host-facing built-in functions. A user authorized to run native queries or actions can invoke FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, CSVREAD, CSVWRITE, or LINK_SCHEMA to read or write arbitrary files on the Metabase server or link other databases. The default sample database uses H2, so the vulnerable surface is exposed by default. This issue is fixed in versions 1.58.16, 1.59.13, 1.60.9, and 1.61.4.
CVE-2026-103928.summary_ko: Metabase의 H2 데이터 소스 관련 네이티브 쿼리 및 액션 처리에서 호스트 내장 함수 제한이 누락되어, 권한 있는 사용자가 임의 파일을 읽거나 쓸 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Metabase의 내장 H2 기능 제한 부재로 임의 파일 읽기 및 쓰기가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-53709.description: MCP Context Forge is an MCP gateway and administrative platform. Prior to 1.0.2, mcpgateway/config.py and .env.example ship a known JWT_SECRET_KEY, while verify_jwt_token() accepts HS256 tokens signed with that key and get_current_user() creates a platform administrator when the token subject matches PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAIL and REQUIRE_USER_IN_DB is false. A remote unauthenticated attacker can therefore mint accepted administrator tokens without a database account. While the vulnerable signing key remains configured and the platform-admin bootstrap remains enabled, forged access survives password rotation, account deletion, and session revocation, allowing administrative disclosure, modification, and service disruption. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.2.
CVE-2026-53709.summary_ko: MCP Context Forge에서 기본 설정된 알려진 JWT_SECRET_KEY와 인증 로직으로 인해 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 관리자 토큰을 위조하여 플랫폼 관리자 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 하드코딩된 JWT 키와 인증 취약점으로 인해 원격에서 관리자 권한 토큰 위조가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-69227.description: A flaw in Portal for ArcGIS allows unauthenticated access to certain Portal Administrator API endpoints under specific conditions. This could enable an attacker to access administrative functionality that should require authentication.

4a89e4a33ab56bb4c80c4533.title_original: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
4a89e4a33ab56bb4c80c4533.excerpt: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today’s epic patch batch dwarfs September’s record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond. Just one of the weaknesses patched this week is considered a “zero day,” or already exploited in the wild. CVE-2026-96951 is a security feature bypass in the Windows Shell that affects Windows 10 and 11 systems, as well as some Server versions. Windows 10 users might be wondering if they can still expect security updates after this month. Microsoft had been slated to stop shipping updates for Windows 10 systems in October 2025, but ended up adding another year of free updates after considerable pushback. A few months ago, Microsoft quietly extended that support for another year (until October 2027). At least 78 of the flaws fixed this month are rated “critical,” meaning they could be exploited with little or no action by the user, and most of those critical bugs allow an attacker to execute code of their choice on the vulnerable system. While Microsoft said there are no signs anyone is exploiting it yet, a security feature bypass in the .NET Framework ( CVE-2026-108398 ) was publicly disclosed prior to today, potentially giving attackers advance time to work out how to exploit the bug. Satnam Narang at Tenable said the number of flaws fixed this month far surpasses the previous record-setting year

77bc0a58b7473431d6de0094.title_original: Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence
77bc0a58b7473431d6de0094.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the refer

09a1f1c9af58f206343f104d.title_original: The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science
09a1f1c9af58f206343f104d.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performan

e6b117cdca0ae43d908cdcaa.title_original: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
e6b117cdca0ae43d908cdcaa.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14118v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ClawLoop, a framework that enables self-improving without any external teacher model and with minimal prior dependencies. ClawLoop composes three phases into a self-sustaining cycle: Task Synthesis, which generates a diverse pool of training tasks via two complementary construction routines, applies diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth followed by both agent-free and agent-based task validation; Training, which updates the agent via SFT and/or RL; and Diagnosis and Feedback, which analyzes the agent's rollout behaviors to produce a capability analysis report that will be used as feedback for task synthesis in the next iteration. Using Qwen3.6-27B

22fccd295cb8506f839ea4b5.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14136v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without gu

3278413e7e0bf3f748242258.title_original: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress
3278413e7e0bf3f748242258.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. We present Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0), an extension of Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench that preserves its 46 original tasks while correcting task and evaluation-infrastructure defects and extending 31 tasks. LHTB 2.0 contains 77 tasks across 13 domains and eight task types. The extended tasks are produced through a systematic reconstruction-task pipeline. We start from a working scientific or engineering artifact, then use a parameterized reference implementation to generate multiple scenarios, reveal six as behavioral evidence, hold out three for evaluation, and use dense progress ladders to reward partial progress while preventing memorization of public outputs. We also extend the evaluation horizon from 90 minutes to three hours and record verifier checkpoints every 30 minutes, enabling direct measurement of sustained progress within a run. Across 1,145 scored model-task runs from 15 frontier models, GPT-6-astra leads with dense mean reward 0.69 and 37 tasks at R at least 0.95, followed by GPT-5.6-sol with dense mean reward 0.67 and 32 tasks at the same threshold. On the 30 reconstruction tasks, binary verifier scores average 0.221, whereas dense ladder scores average 0.653, showing that outcome-only evaluation discards substantial i

c3385648226d4e1e702e181e.title_original: VETNET: Assembling Benchmark Datasets for AI-Driven Veterinary Innovation
c3385648226d4e1e702e181e.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: VETNET represents an ecosystem of live benchmark datasets and evaluation frameworks designed to accelerate AI-driven innovation in animal science and veterinary medicine through standardized, high-quality datasets and multi-institutional collaboration across academic and non-academic sectors. This framework addresses the gap between AI advances in human medicine and the fragmented state of veterinary AI development.

3643d129e9cd16fdeb75408c.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. At the published limit the leading open-weight and closed models cannot be distinguished. With the limit relaxed, the models it was truncating recover, and the highest rewards belong to open-weight models. Among the leading models, price is a poor guide to capability: models with similar rewards differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. Because the benchmark's checkpoint scores largely record what an agent did or mentioned, we also introduce stage-level metrics that score what the agent submits, by executing its detection queries in the telemetr

6b210003cb0f28146d6019b2.title_original: Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function
6b210003cb0f28146d6019b2.excerpt: arXiv:2610.14186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Could model-free reinforcement learning algorithms actually be learning a model of the environment? In this work, we apply counterfactual interventions which hold everything about a state fixed, besides a targeted change, to explore if the value function of a Proximal Policy Optimization agent forms a world model of the Crafter environment. Despite only being trained to optimize reward, we discover that the value function learns concepts such as the rules governing when a diamond is collectible, water and food having an impact on health, heuristics regarding inventory, and more.
