CVE-2026-111221.description: Netgate pfSense CE through 2.9.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows authenticated WebGUI users to inject mpd5 commands by submitting an unescaped RADIUS shared secret. Attackers with L2TP or PPPoE Server edit privileges can POST a secret containing a quote and newline to vpn_l2tp.php or services_pppoe_edit.php, appending an up-script that executes as root when a session starts.

CVE-2026-111222.description: Netgate pfSense CE through 2.9.0 contains a php.ini injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with General Setup privileges to inject directives by submitting an unvalidated timezone value. Attackers can embed a quote and newline to add auto_prepend_file pointing at /var/db/zoneinfo, executing PHP as root after php.ini is regenerated at boot or php-fpm restart.

CVE-2026-111223.description: Netgate pfSense CE 2.7.0 through 2.9.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with IPsec Mobile privileges to execute commands as root via the login_banner field. Attackers can submit a single-line banner containing '}' to escape the unquoted strongswan.conf attr value and define charon.start-scripts entries that charon executes as root on restart.

CVE-2026-111224.description: pfSense CE through 2.9.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the OpenVPN openvpn.connect_async.sh script that allows authenticated VPN users to execute commands as root via crafted usernames. Attackers authenticated through RADIUS or LDAP can use usernames containing single quotes and shell metacharacters to break out of the eval'd pfctl anchor name on connect or disconnect.

CVE-2026-111225.description: Netgate pfSense CE 2.5.0 through 2.9.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in openvpn.learn-address.sh that allows authenticated VPN clients to execute commands as the unbound user. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters in the certificate common name or username, which is interpolated unquoted into su -c strings, when DNS Resolver client registration is enabled.

CVE-2026-111226.description: pfSense CE 2.4.5 through 2.9.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated WebGUI users with Advanced Admin Access privilege to execute commands as root via Login Protection settings. Attackers can submit sshguard threshold, block time, or detection time values containing newlines or $(...) that are written unvalidated to sshguard.conf and sourced as root on restart.

CVE-2026-111227.description: Netgate pfSense CE through 2.9.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability in services_unbound_acls.php that allows authenticated users with the DNS Resolver: Access Lists privilege to inject Unbound configuration directives. Attackers can embed CR/LF characters in the aclname or aclaction fields written to access_lists.conf to add local-data, local-zone, or forward-zone directives and control DNS answers served to LAN clients.

CVE-2026-111228.description: Netgate pfSense CE from 2.7.1 through 2.9.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability in services_unbound_advanced.php that allows authenticated users with DNS Resolver: Advanced privilege to inject Unbound directives. Attackers can embed CR/LF characters in the unvalidated sock_queue_timeout parameter, which is written raw into unbound.conf, to override local records and forwarding for all clients.

CVE-2026-111229.description: pfSense CE 2.7.0 through 2.9.0 contains a command injection vulnerability in services_captiveportal_hasync.php that allows users with only the Captive Portal HA privilege to execute commands as root. Attackers can set backwardsyncip to a malicious XMLRPC server returning connected_users with shell metacharacters in ip or mac fields, which captiveportal_load_pfctl passes unescaped to a pfctl shell command.

CVE-2026-111230.description: Netgate pfSense CE through 2.9.0 contains a local file read vulnerability that allows users with the Dynamic DNS client privilege to read files as root by setting a file:// custom Update URL in services_dyndns_edit.php. Attackers can set a non-matching Result Match string so _checkStatus() logs file contents such as /conf/config.xml or /etc/master.passwd to the system log.

CVE-2026-111231.description: Netgate pfSense CE through 2.9.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows read-only WebGUI users to replace config.xml because config_restore() and config_install() ignore the 'User - Config: Deny Config Write' privilege. Attackers holding page privileges for services_acb.php, uploadconfig.php, diag_confbak.php, or diag_backup.php can install a chosen config.xml to gain root-level code execution after reload or reboot.

CVE-2026-111232.description: Netgate pfSense CE 2.3.0 through 2.9.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Firewall: Rules or NAT: Port Forward privileges to inject scripts via the separator color field. Attackers can submit a crafted separator[] color value that display_separator() renders unencoded into class attributes, executing in administrators' browsers to perform WebGUI actions with their privileges.

CVE-2026-111233.description: Netgate pfSense CE 2.7.1 through 2.9.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in firewall_rules.php that allows remote attackers to inject script via the unencoded if parameter. When the non-default Require Firewall Interface option is enabled, attackers can lure users with firewall rules privileges into opening a crafted GET link to execute script in the WebGUI with their privileges.

CVE-2026-111234.description: SimplePie through 1.9.0 contains a local file read vulnerability that allows malicious feed servers to read server files by supplying file:// URLs in redirects or autodiscovery links. Attackers can return a Location header or feed link pointing to a file:// path, causing file_get_contents() to read files accessible to the web server process.

CVE-2026-111235.description: An authorization bypass vulnerability exists in the REST API of multiple versions of OpenNMS Meridian and Horizon. The /rest/** Spring Security filter chains authorize requests with intercept-url rules that name the HTTP method as an uppercase token, compare the method case-sensitively, and have no terminal deny rule. A request that uses a non-canonical (for example lowercase) method token matches no rule and is processed without authentication. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can read the monitored inventory and can create, modify, or delete resources through the REST API, which includes injecting events to fabricate or suppress alarms. The /rest/alarms chain has the same missing deny rule and discloses whether an alarm exists through a difference in the response. The fix adds a terminal deny rule to each REST filter chain. The solution is to upgrade to Meridian 2024.3.14, 2025.0.11, 2026.0.1 and Horizon 36.0.5 or newer. Meridian and Horizon installation instructions state that they are intended for installation within an organization's private networks and should not be directly accessible from the Internet.

CVE-2026-111252.description: A denial of service vulnerability exists in the XML parsing of multiple versions of OpenNMS Meridian and Horizon. OpenNMS parsed XML without an effective limit on entity expansion. A document with a DOCTYPE that declares internal entities can expand to a very large value and exhaust the server memory. An authenticated user with provisioning access can supply such a document through a requisition or foreign-source import, which includes a remote requisition URL that the server fetches and parses. Both deeply nested entities and a single large entity referenced many times cause the memory exhaustion. The fix caps the number of entity expansions for all XML parsing and rejects any DOCTYPE in requisition and foreign-source XML. The solution is to upgrade to Meridian 2024.3.14, 2025.0.11, 2026.0.1 and Horizon 36.0.5 or newer. Meridian and Horizon installation instructions state that they are intended for installation within an organization's private networks and should not be directly accessible from the Internet.

CVE-2026-36436.description: An issue in Trisolutions BRPerfX version 1.4.4.0 exposes LDAP credentials in plaintext within the administrative configuration interface. An authenticated administrator can inspect the client-side code to retrieve the credential.

CVE-2026-45165.description: An authorization flaw in Idira Conjur version 13.9.0 allows an authenticated user with limited privileges to perform unauthorized actions on a policy branch. Under specific circumstances, an attacker could potentially leverage this to retrieve unauthorized secrets, alter administrative access controls on the branch or cause a denial of service (DoS). Idira Security Bulletin CA26-38.

CVE-2026-47218.description: runwasi facilitates running Wasm and WASI workloads managed by containerd. Prior to 0.6.1, containerd-shim-wasmtime-v1 can treat Wasmtime precompiled bytes supplied directly in an OCI image layer as a trusted artifact from the precompile-cache path and deserialize them as native code. An attacker who causes a victim to run a crafted image can bypass WebAssembly validation and execute native code in the shim zygote process, gaining the filesystem, environment, credentials, networking, and Linux syscall access available to the workload container. Downstream shims built with runwasi's containerd-shim-wasm precompile-cache API are also affected if they implement Compiler and trust executable precompiled artifacts from OCI image layers; the 0.6.1 boundary applies specifically to containerd-shim-wasmtime and does not independently certify downstream product releases. The flaw escapes the WASI sandbox to the workload container boundary, but it does not by itself bypass container isolation or provide direct host code execution. This issue is fixed in version 0.6.1.

CVE-2026-55239.description: Tianji is an open source analytics, uptime monitoring, and server status platform. Prior to 1.31.29, the getDateQuery() function in src/server/utils/prisma.ts constructs raw SQL through Prisma.sql() by interpolating the timezone request value without parameter binding. The timezone value can reach affected analytics queries through request data or the timezone HTTP header, and workspaceProcedure permits any authenticated workspace member, including a read-only viewer, to reach those queries. An attacker can execute arbitrary SQL against the shared PostgreSQL database, which can disclose or modify credentials, API keys, and tenant data or make the service unavailable. This issue is fixed in version 1.31.29.

CVE-2026-55240.description: Tianji is an open source analytics, uptime monitoring, and server status platform. Prior to 1.31.29, formatString() in src/server/utils/template.ts passes survey feedTemplate and monitor notification templates to lodash template(), while the default evaluate pattern remains enabled. A workspace administrator can store an evaluate block using the <% code %> form, and the public survey.submit endpoint renders a survey template when an unauthenticated user submits a response. The compiled template executes server-side JavaScript in the Tianji Node.js process, allowing command execution, secret disclosure, data modification, or service disruption. This issue is fixed in version 1.31.29.

CVE-2026-55587.description: AliasVault is a privacy-first password manager with built-in email aliasing. Prior to 0.29.4, the AliasVault browser extension passkey provider does not bind passkey requests to the actual webpage origin or verify that the requested relying-party identifier matches the current website. A malicious website can provide forged origin and relying-party values and, if a victim with a matching stored passkey approves the AliasVault passkey prompt, obtain a valid assertion for a different website. Exploitation requires the extension to be installed, unlocked, and configured as a passkey provider, requires a stored passkey for the impersonated site, and cannot occur silently because the victim must approve the prompt. The server, web application, and mobile applications are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.29.4.

CVE-2026-55840.description: Scoold is a Q&A and a knowledge sharing platform for teams. Prior to 1.69.1, the getBackToUrl() method in src/main/java/com/erudika/scoold/utils/HttpUtils.java validates the backto and returnto parameters with Strings.CI.startsWith against the configured server URL. An attacker can supply an absolute URL whose hostname begins with the legitimate hostname, causing URI.resolve() to retain the attacker URL and the prefix check to accept it. A victim who follows the crafted sign-in link can be redirected to an attacker-controlled domain after authentication, enabling phishing and possible credential or token theft. This issue is fixed in version 1.69.1.

CVE-2026-55842.description: Scoold is a Q&A and a knowledge sharing platform for teams. Prior to 1.69.1, the apiCorsConfiguration() method in src/main/java/com/erudika/scoold/ScooldServer.java combines addAllowedOriginPattern("*") with setAllowCredentials(true), causing Spring to reflect any requesting origin while allowing cookies or session tokens. A malicious website visited by a logged-in Scoold user can therefore issue authenticated API requests, read user data, questions, and configuration, and trigger state-changing operations on the user's behalf. This issue is fixed in version 1.69.1.

CVE-2026-55871.description: GYM One is open-source gym management software for fitness centers, personal trainers, and sports clubs. Prior to 1.4.1, GYM One's admin/users/index.php concatenates the search_name and search_email GET parameters into both the user-list query and the COUNT query used for pagination without prepared statements. An authenticated administrator can inject SQL through either search field to read data from arbitrary tables, including user information and password hashes. Depending on database permissions, the same injection may also permit filesystem writes. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.1.

CVE-2026-55872.description: GYM One is open-source gym management software for fitness centers, personal trainers, and sports clubs. Prior to 1.4.1, GYM One's admin/users/index.php renders the stored firstname, lastname, and email profile fields into the administrator user list without HTML output encoding. An attacker who can store values in those fields can cause content to execute in an administrator's browser when the administrator visits /admin/users/. The persistent script can access administrator-session data or perform actions with the administrator's privileges until the stored record is removed. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.1.

CVE-2026-57183.description: Scoold is a Q&A and a knowledge sharing platform for teams. Prior to 1.69.1, checkApiAuth() in src/main/java/com/erudika/scoold/utils/ScooldUtils.java accepts a JWT signed with app_secret_key or para_secret_key for /api/config and /api/stats without requiring a registered API-key jti, and maps the request to the hardcoded administrative API_USER. The special endpoint checks run even when scoold.api_enabled is false. An attacker who obtains either signing secret can forge a token that reads sensitive configuration and server logs and reaches privileged configuration functionality, while an ordinary login-session token is not sufficient. This issue is fixed in version 1.69.1.

CVE-2026-57496.description: NetLicensing MCP Server is a natural-language interface that enables agentic applications to manage the software-licensing lifecycle in Labs64 NetLicensing. Prior to 0.1.8, netlicensing_get_product passes the caller-controlled product_number to src/netlicensing_mcp/tools/products.py, which interpolates it into a REST path consumed by nl_get() in src/netlicensing_mcp/client.py without path-segment validation. A traversal segment can be normalized from the intended product path to the /token endpoint, after which the response is serialized through _wrap_json instead of _wrap_json_token_read, bypassing redact_token_read() protections for APIKEY number and SHOP shopURL fields. An authenticated MCP client with a non-administrative API key can retrieve plaintext token values, and a recovered administrative token can provide broad read, write, and delete access to the NetLicensing account. This issue is fixed in version 0.1.8.

CVE-2026-62322.description: Python Social Auth is a social authentication/registration mechanism. Prior to 5.0.2, the LINE backend exchanges an authorization code without validating the returned OAuth state. An attacker can begin authorization for an attacker-controlled LINE account and induce a victim to visit the resulting callback URL, causing the application to log the victim into the attacker's account. When account linking is enabled, the same missing validation can link the attacker's LINE identity to the victim's existing account and create a persistent unauthorized login path. Only applications with the LINE backend enabled are affected. This issue is fixed in version 5.0.2.

CVE-2026-63430.description: ammonia is a Rust library for repairing and securing untrusted HTML. Prior to 3.3.2, 4.0.2, and 4.1.3, applications that explicitly allow the math tag, annotation-xml, and at least one raw-text HTML element while disallowing the encoding attribute can permit mutation cross-site scripting. ammonia does not correctly implement annotation-xml's encoding-dependent MathML integration-point behavior after attribute filtering removes encoding, so the sanitizer validates a descendant under one namespace interpretation while the browser reparses the output under another. An attacker can use that namespace transition and an allowed raw-text HTML element to execute JavaScript when a user renders the sanitized output. The required tags are not enabled by default, so applications that do not explicitly allow them are not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 3.3.2, 4.0.2, and 4.1.3.

CVE-2026-87018.description: undici is an HTTP client library for Node.js. In versions 4.2.1 through 6.29.0, 7.0.0 through 7.30.0, and 8.0.0 through 8.12.1, the client process crashes when a TLS 1.2 server renegotiates after the connection is established and presents a different, CA-trusted certificate whose hostname does not match the requested host. Node.js re-runs hostname verification on the renegotiated handshake and destroys the socket with a certificate-altname error, but undici's established-socket error handler asserted that this error code could never occur, so the peer-controlled error became an uncaught assertion that terminates the Node.js process, affecting both the HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 paths. A malicious or compromised HTTPS endpoint reached through undici or the global fetch() can crash the client with a single server-initiated renegotiation, taking down all in-flight requests and background work in the process, and exploitation needs no CA compromise because the attacker controls the endpoint and can present two ordinary valid certificates. Only TLS 1.2 is affected, since TLS 1.3 does not support renegotiation. The issue is fixed in undici 6.29.1, 7.30.1, and 8.12.2, and users should upgrade to one of those versions or later. As a workaround, restrict outbound connections to TLS 1.3 so renegotiation cannot occur, when the target endpoints support it.

CVE-2026-87029.description: undici is an HTTP client library for Node.js. In versions 7.15.0 through 7.30.0 and 8.0.0 through 8.12.1, its decompress interceptor forwards decompressed response data to the downstream handler from zlib stream event callbacks without catching exceptions those callbacks may throw, and while undici's engine converts a synchronous throw from a downstream handler into a per-request failure, that protection is absent when the throw happens asynchronously from a zlib callback. As a result, a downstream handler that throws by design, such as the built-in dump interceptor which throws when a response exceeds its configured maximum size, escapes as an uncaught exception that terminates the Node.js process. A malicious or compromised HTTP server can crash any client that composes the decompress interceptor with such a handler by returning a small compressed body that decompresses to more than the configured limit, so only the decompressed size matters and the bytes on the wire stay tiny. The issue is fixed in undici 7.30.1 and 8.12.2, and users should upgrade to one of those versions or later. As a workaround, avoid composing the decompress interceptor with a response handler that throws during response processing until upgrading.

CVE-2026-92707.description: MessagePack for C# is a MessagePack serializer for C#. Prior to 2.5.303 and 3.1.9, deserializing attacker-controlled MessagePack data as System.Object through PrimitiveObjectFormatter can cause excessive memory allocation. The formatter allocates an object[] from each declared array length before the configured object-graph depth limit rejects the input, while nested array headers can reuse the same trailing unread bytes to satisfy per-header length validation. A comparatively small payload can therefore keep many large arrays alive at once. When an attacker can submit such data repeatedly, the allocations can cause severe managed-heap pressure, excessive garbage collection, process termination, or loss of service. Exposure requires an application to deserialize untrusted data through the affected formatter path and permit repeated attacker-controlled submissions, such as a reachable ASP.NET Core SignalR hub method with an object parameter and AddMessagePackProtocol() enabled. This issue is fixed in versions 2.5.303 and 3.1.9.

CVE-2026-94621.description: AliasVault is a privacy-first password manager with built-in email aliasing. Prior to 0.30.3, the AliasVault server API favicon extractor validates a user-supplied hostname with a first DNS lookup but allows the HTTP client to perform a second DNS lookup when connecting. An authenticated low-privileged user operating an attacker-controlled authoritative DNS server can return a public address during validation and a private address during connection, causing a publicly reachable self-hosted server to issue HTTP or HTTPS requests to internal hosts. A valid image response is returned in Base64 form, while other responses can expose limited timing and error information for internal-network reconnaissance. Exploitation requires a publicly reachable self-hosted instance with public registration enabled, an authenticated AliasVault account, an attacker-controlled authoritative DNS server, and a resolver that permits rebinding; default checks limit requests to ports 80 and 443. The browser extensions, web application, and mobile applications are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.30.3.

CVE-2026-96449.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPExperts WP EasyPay wp-easy-pay allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP EasyPay: from n/a through 4.5.4.

CVE-2026-97370.description: Junrar is an open source Java RAR archive library. Prior to 7.6.1, RarVM.ExecuteCode in src/main/java/com/github/junrar/unpack/vm/RarVM.java can repeatedly execute a VM_JMP instruction whose target is greater than or equal to the prepared program's codeSize. The setIP() function returns success without changing the instruction pointer or decrementing maxOpCount, and the jump handler continues before loop-end accounting, leaving both values unchanged. A crafted RAR4 archive can therefore keep an extraction thread in an infinite CPU loop and exhaust archive-processing worker capacity. The RAR virtual machine does not expose native process execution, so the supported impact is availability loss rather than code execution. This issue is fixed in version 7.6.1.

CVE-2026-104198.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. In versions 1.34.0 through 1.36.38, the web interface mishandles failed token authentication in web/includes/auth.php. validateToken() returns false when a token is malformed or has an invalid signature, but the caller assigns that value to the global $user variable; because web/index.php tests isset($user), boolean false is treated as a present user and the normal login redirect is skipped. This can dispatch views that rely on the outer authentication gate, including the zones view, which accepts an attacker-selected monitor ID and discloses monitor and zone metadata without an independent permission check. Permission helpers receive the false user value and deny privileged operations, so unauthorized state changes have not been established. This vulnerability is fixed in version 1.36.63, where conversion to ZM\User objects causes invalid token state to fail before view dispatch. Later defense-in-depth changes explicitly leave $user unset after failed token validation and reject non-ZM\User values at the web authentication gate.

CVE-2026-106700.description: ELADMIN v2.7 and earlier contains an improper access control vulnerability in the user-management endpoint PUT /api/users/resetPwd of me.zhengjie.modules.system.rest.UserController. The method lacks the method-level authorization check applied to all other user-management endpoints and performs no role-level or ownership validation in UserServiceImpl.resetPwd. Any authenticated user of any role can reset the password of arbitrary users, including the built-in administrator.

CVE-2026-106708.description: XXL-JOB 3.5.0-SNAPSHOT and earlier contains a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the user management controller (JobUserController). The endpoints /user/insert, /user/update, and /user/delete lack CSRF protection and do not restrict HTTP method.

CVE-2026-102764.description: The vulnerability exists within internal components of BeyondTrust’s Remote Support product. The components did not adequately validate the origin of the messages it received. Under the right conditions, this could allow an attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

CVE-2026-105032.description: The EnergizeLab Eilik and EilikO AI skill upload endpoint, served by the FastAPI AI inference and profiling services, does not require authentication and does not constrain uploaded file paths. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use path traversal to write arbitrary files, and thereby tamper with AI skill files used by Eilik and EilikO robots.

CVE-2026-105033.description: The EnergizeLab AI Station (RK3562) firmware image ships with default root credentials and SSH enabled. An attacker with network access to the device can log in as root and take full control of it.

CVE-2026-105034.description: The EnergizeLab Eilik NestJS auth service issues device tokens for arbitrary robot serial numbers without authentication. An unauthenticated remote attacker can obtain a valid device token for any serial number and act as that device against the cloud services.

CVE-2026-105035.description: The EnergizeLab FirmwareUpdater (AArch64 ELF, distributed in the CDN bin.zip) uses a single hard-coded AES key shared by all installations. An attacker who recovers the key from the updater can decrypt and forge firmware packages for any device that trusts it.

CVE-2026-105036.description: EnergizeLab AI Station firmware, EilikO Linux robot firmware v2.1_20260617182218_release, and the EnergizeLab Windows desktop app 3.1.2 download firmware updates over plain HTTP and do not verify their integrity or authenticity. An attacker able to intercept or modify the traffic can substitute a malicious update.

CVE-2026-105037.description: EnergizeLab station-middleware (NestJS) Docker images 1.6.5 through 1.8.2 allow any registered, low-privilege account to read arbitrary files from the server by supplying an attacker-controlled file path. This exposes middleware files and server secrets.

CVE-2026-105038.description: The EnergizeLab Eilik and EilikO FastAPI AI inference and profiling services expose AI model administration functions without authentication. An unauthenticated remote attacker can change AI model configuration and switch the model in use at runtime.

CVE-2026-105039.description: EnergizeLab station-middleware (NestJS) Docker images 1.6.5 through 1.8.2 do not check user roles on administrative APIs. Any authenticated low-privilege user can retrieve AI provider keys and change configuration and object-store contents.

CVE-2026-105040.description: The EnergizeLab Eilik NestJS auth service accepts a user-controlled user ID in account update requests (mass assignment). A registered user can set another account's identifier and take over that account.

CVE-2026-109468.description: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling in ASP.NET Core allows an unauthorized attacker to deny service over a network.

CVE-2026-111357.description: Ivanti Connect Secure 22.8R2.4 mishandles the manner in which the dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, leading to privilege escalation to root, as exploited in the wild in October 2026.
CVE-2026-111357.summary_ko: Ivanti Connect Secure의 DSCache 구성 데이터 처리 결함으로 인해 root 권한으로의 권한 상승이 발생할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2024-58397.description: MP4v2 through 2.1.3 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read in MP4File::GetChapters() that allows attackers to read past heap allocations via crafted QuickTime chapter samples. Attackers can supply an MP4 file whose chapter sample is shorter than its declared title length, crashing applications like mp4chaps or leaking adjacent heap memory into chapter titles.

CVE-2026-110913.description: Memory corruption in DOM in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE-2026-110914.description: Memory corruption in Workers in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

CVE-2026-110915.description: Use after free in Compositing in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

CVE-2026-110916.description: Improper input validation in Desktop in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

CVE-2026-110917.description: Memory corruption in SVG in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to read memory via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE-2026-110918.description: Memory corruption in Core in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to read memory via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE-2026-110919.description: Use after free in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE-2026-110920.description: Memory corruption in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE-2026-110921.description: Use after free in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

CVE-2026-110922.description: Use after free in Prerender in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.84 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)

CVE-2026-111269.description: libical through 4.0.6 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read in icalvalue_decode_ical_string() in src/libical/icalvalue.c when decoding input ending in a backslash. Attackers can supply escaped iCalendar text with a trailing backslash, causing the loop to read past the terminator and crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory.

CVE-2026-111270.description: libmodplug through 0.8.9.1 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write in CSoundFile::ReadDSM() in src/load_dsm.cpp because nPat is never checked against MAX_PATTERNS. Attackers can supply a crafted DSM file with over 240 PATT chunks or a wrapping patt_len value to corrupt heap memory and crash the consuming process.

CVE-2026-111271.description: libmodplug through 0.8.9.1 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability in CSoundFile::ReadAMS2() in src/load_ams.cpp that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory via crafted AMS files. Attackers can supply an AMS module whose pattern effect bytes keep bit 7 set, driving the decoder past the input buffer and crashing any libmodplug consumer.

CVE-2026-111272.description: LibRaw through 0.22.2 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read in LibRaw::parseNikonMakernote() that allows attackers to read past a short ShotInfo buffer. Attackers can supply a crafted Nikon NEF/TIFF with a 5-byte ShotInfo tag declaring version 243 to crash applications decoding the image.

CVE-2026-111273.description: unarr through 1.1.1 contains an off-by-one heap-based buffer overflow in tar_get_name() in tar/parse-tar.c, reachable through the ar_entry_get_name() API. Attackers can supply a crafted TAR archive with a full ustar prefix and name to write a NUL byte past the allocation, corrupting heap memory and crashing the process.

CVE-2026-111274.description: unarr through 1.1.1 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read in zip_parse_extra_fields() in zip/parse-zip.c due to an incorrect ZIP64 extra field length check. Attackers can supply a crafted ZIP archive with 0xFFFFFFFF sentinel values and a truncated ZIP64 record to read past the heap buffer and crash the process.

CVE-2026-111275.description: nifti_clib through 3.0.1 contains a stack-based out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in nifti_convert_n2hdr2nim() because the NIfTI-2 dim[0] value is never range-checked. Attackers can supply a crafted 540-byte NIfTI-2 header read via nifti_image_read() to crash applications or corrupt stack memory.

CVE-2026-111277.description: NivoCart through 2.5.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the download() action of account/order that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve guest order invoices by supplying an order_id. Attackers can iterate the order_id parameter, which matches guest orders stored with customer_id 0, to disclose guest names, addresses, telephone numbers, emails, purchased items, and totals.

CVE-2026-111278.description: NivoCart through 2.5.1 contains a CAPTCHA bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to defeat form protection because the expected code is printed as plain text in the HTML. Attackers can fetch protected forms, extract the captcha_image value with a pattern match, and submit it to automate spam, registrations, reviews, and account deletion requests.

CVE-2026-111279.description: Dragonfly through 2.0.2 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated clients to exhaust memory by passing a negative COUNT to HRANDFIELD, ZRANDMEMBER or SRANDMEMBER. Attackers can send a single command against a one-element key with a huge negative COUNT to trigger the OOM killer, terminating the instance for all clients.

CVE-2026-111280.description: snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadArea() that allows malicious S7 peers to overflow client buffers via an unchecked DataLength field. Rogue or impersonated PLCs can return crafted ReadVar responses causing memcpy of up to 65535 bytes into caller buffers, crashing SCADA, HMI, or gateway processes and corrupting memory.

CVE-2026-111281.description: Jooan JA-A12 IP cameras with firmware 009_20171107 and 05.02.31.105 contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to run root commands via hard-coded credentials. Attackers send singleCMD=SetDiagMode to /goform/SingleHandlebyCommand with an attacker-chosen authserverip and authcode, making the jooandiag daemon execute their commands through /bin/sh, giving full device control.
CVE-2026-111281.summary_ko: Jooan JA-A12 IP 카메라에 하드코딩된 자격 증명을 사용하여 인증되지 않은 공격자가 루트 명령을 실행할 수 있는 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-111282.description: Driftregion iso14229 before 0.10.1 contains an integer wraparound in Handle_0x38_RequestFileTransfer that lets unauthenticated attackers bypass the file path length check. Attackers can send a short RequestFileTransfer (SID 0x38) request with filePathAndNameLength 0xFFFC-0xFFFF, causing callbacks to read past the receive buffer, crashing targets or disclosing memory.

CVE-2026-111283.description: BMC Helix Network Management on-prem before 26.3.01 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as the local administrator with any password when SAML single sign-on is configured. Attackers can submit the administrator username with an arbitrary password on the web login page to obtain a SuperAdmin session, modify device credentials, run device commands, and alter audit records.
CVE-2026-111283.summary_ko: 온프레미스 BMC Helix Network Management에서 SAML 싱글 사인온이 설정된 경우 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의의 비밀번호로 로컬 관리자 로그인을 우회하여 슈퍼관리자 세션을 획득할 수 있는 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-111284.description: Aureus ERP through 1.6.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in HolidayAction.php that allows authenticated users to inject scripts via unescaped holiday names rendered as HtmlString. Attackers permitted to create Public Holidays or Mandatory Days can store JavaScript payloads that execute when HR managers or administrators open the Holiday modal, hijacking their sessions.

CVE-2026-111312.description: OpenHealth through 0.2.0 contains a missing authentication and authorization vulnerability in the /api/health-data/[id] GET, PATCH and DELETE handlers that query records by id without session or authorId checks. Unauthenticated attackers who know a HealthData record id can read another user's medical record data and file metadata, overwrite it with arbitrary JSON, or delete it.

CVE-2026-111313.description: JobOps through 0.13.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the POST /api/manual-jobs/fetch handler that allows authenticated users, or unauthenticated clients in demo mode, to make the server fetch internal destinations. Attackers can supply loopback, private, or cloud metadata addresses in the url field to read returned page content, disclosing instance metadata and internal service data.

CVE-2026-111320.description: ValueCell through 0.1.20 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to direct backend requests by setting an unvalidated provider base_url. Attackers can set base_url via the provider config endpoint and trigger POST /api/v1/models/check to reach internal or metadata addresses, read error responses, and capture stored provider API keys.

CVE-2026-111321.description: TaskingAI through 0.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to make the backend send arbitrary HTTP requests by supplying an unvalidated OpenAPI servers[0].url in a user-defined action. Attackers holding a project API key or console admin login can create an action pointing to loopback, internal or cloud metadata addresses and run it via POST /actions/{action_id}/run to read back up to 64 KiB of responses.

CVE-2026-111322.description: Archon 0.2.13 through 0.11.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access the /api/* control API, which binds to 0.0.0.0 by default. Attackers with network access can send messages to the AI coding agent, which runs with bypassPermissions, to execute commands on the host as the Archon user.
CVE-2026-111322.summary_ko: Archon에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크 접근을 통해 바이패스 권한으로 실행되는 AI 코딩 Agent 제어 API에 접근하여 호스트에서 명령을 실행할 수 있는 인증 누락 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-111323.description: RedAmon through 7.0.1 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability in the agent POST /tradecraft/verify endpoint because validate_url checks only the initial hostname. Attackers can submit a public URL that redirects or DNS-rebinds to internal addresses like cloud metadata services, receiving fetched content through the model-generated summary.

CVE-2026-111324.description: rustdesk-api through 2.7 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite existing peer records by supplying only a target device ID to POST /api/sysinfo. Attackers can overwrite hostname, username, OS and uuid without uuid verification, then log in presenting that uuid to rebind the peer to their account.

CVE-2026-111329.description: JuggleIM im-server through 1.8.16 ships default administrator credentials admin/123456 that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to access the admin console on port 8090. Attackers can log in as administrator, even after account deletion since CheckLogin recreates it, to control tenant applications and app secrets.

CVE-2026-111330.description: JuggleIM im-server through 1.8.16 contains a weak password hashing vulnerability that stores admin console passwords as unsalted SHA-1 digests via tools.SHA1 in services/accountservice.go. Attackers who obtain the accounts table through database access or backups can crack console passwords using precomputed tables or GPU brute force.

CVE-2026-111331.description: Dokploy through 0.30.8 contains a cross-organization authorization bypass in the port tRPC router that allows authenticated owners or admins of any organization to manage other tenants' ports because the target application's organization is never verified. Attackers supplying a known portId or applicationId to port.create, port.one, port.update, or port.delete can read, modify, delete, or add port mappings, disrupting how victim services are published.

CVE-2026-111332.description: OxiCloud 0.9.1 through 0.9.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to keep share access after password protection is added. Attackers holding an existing oxi_shares share-ring cookie can request content via GET /api/files/{id} to read shared files or folder contents despite the new password.

CVE-2026-111343.description: pig through 4.1.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in SysUserController.user that allows any authenticated user to read other users' profiles via GET /admin/user/details/{id}. Low-privilege attackers can enumerate sequential user ids to obtain usernames, real names, phone numbers, emails, linked third-party accounts, and role assignments.

CVE-2026-111344.description: APITable through 1.14.0-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read node descriptions from other spaces by supplying a user-controlled nodeId. Attackers can request GET /node/{nodeId}/description, which skips space membership and node permission checks, to disclose cross-tenant datasheet, folder, and form descriptions.

CVE-2026-111345.description: Trudesk through 1.2.11 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read private conversations by supplying another conversation's id. Attackers can request GET /api/v1/messages/conversation/:id, which lacks participant checks, to obtain full message history plus participants' usernames, full names and email addresses.

CVE-2026-111346.description: ZenTao PMS through 22.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in action::editComment that allows authenticated users to read and overwrite other users' comments by supplying an arbitrary actionID. Attackers can iterate sequential action ids to modify comments on bugs, stories, tasks, and documents in products and projects they cannot access, and view targeted comment content and attachments.

CVE-2026-111347.description: go-ldap-admin through 0.6.2 embeds a hard-coded RSA private key, published in the public repository, that protects encrypted login passwords. Unauthenticated attackers who capture encrypted passwords can decrypt them offline or via the /base/decryptpwd endpoint, recovering cleartext LDAP credentials for reuse.

CVE-2026-111348.description: Likeshop through 3.5.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in AfterSale.php and AfterSaleLogic.php that lets authenticated users access other customers' after-sale records by supplying their ids. Attackers with self-registered accounts can call the detail, goodsInfo, cancel, express, and again actions to read refund and order data, cancel refunds, overwrite return shipment details, or re-open refused refunds.

CVE-2026-111349.description: Craftplan through 0.7.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the CRM Customer resource that allows unauthenticated attackers to create customer records via JSON:API and GraphQL. Attackers can send anonymous requests to POST /api/json/customers or the create_customer mutation to insert attacker-chosen names, contact details and addresses into the operator's CRM.

CVE-2026-111350.description: Papermark through 0.22.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the data room viewer group API that allows authenticated users to delete other teams' viewer groups and share links. Attackers who know a victim team's data room and group identifiers can send DELETE requests, read group links, or rewrite group document permissions across teams.

CVE-2026-111351.description: metasfresh through 5.175 contains a missing record-level authorization vulnerability in BoardRestController that allows authenticated low-privilege users to bypass role and organization access checks. Attackers can call the getBoard, getCard, addCard, removeCard and patchCard handlers to read records outside their scope and modify board card assignments.

CVE-2026-111352.description: ThinkCMF through 8.0.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in RestAdminBaseController that allows restricted backend administrators to call every admin REST API endpoint because Auth::check() fails open when no admin_api rule exists. Attackers with a valid admin-type API token can list member emails and mobile numbers, disable members, and call PUT admin/roles/{id}/authorize to grant themselves full administrator rights.
CVE-2026-111352.summary_ko: ThinkCMF에서 관리자 API 규칙이 없을 때 권한 검사가 실패하지 않아 제한된 백엔드 관리자가 모든 관리자 REST API 엔드포인트를 호출하고 스스로 최고 관리자 권한을 부여할 수 있는 부적절한 권한 부여 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-111353.description: Peppermint through 0.5.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to create time entries and attachments as other users by supplying a user id in the request body. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/v1/time/new or /api/v1/storage/ticket/:id/upload/single to attach files and time records to any ticket under another user's identity.

CVE-2026-111354.description: crmeb_java through 3.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read other members' orders by supplying their order numbers. Attackers can request /api/front/order/express/{orderId} or /api/front/order/apply/refund/{orderId} to view victims' tracking numbers, logistics traces, payment amounts and product lines.

CVE-2026-111355.description: zhontai Admin.Core through 10.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to ignore department DataScope restrictions by supplying out-of-scope record ids. Attackers holding user or organization module permissions with Dept or Self scope can call UserService and OrgService by-id methods to read, modify, disable, and delete users in other departments.

CVE-2026-111356.description: MacCMS v10 through 2026.1000.4056 does not limit attempts on the six-digit password recovery code, allowing unauthenticated attackers to take over member accounts. Attackers knowing a victim's email or phone can request a code and brute-force findpass_reset to overwrite the member's password.

CVE-2026-111358.description: SendPortal sendportal-core through 4.0.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace members to attach subscribers to other workspaces' tags by supplying unvalidated tag IDs. Attackers can submit sequential tag IDs via the web subscriber form or CSV import to receive victim campaign content and skew victim reports.

CVE-2026-111359.description: CRMEB 5.6.1 through 6.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated storefront users to read and claim other users' orders via the gift-order API. Attackers can enumerate sequential order IDs in gift_detail to harvest buyer identities and the gift_key, then call receive_gift to redirect paid goods to their address.

CVE-2026-111363.description: BISHENG through 3.0.0-beta4 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read other users' parsed documents by supplying arbitrary file_id values. Attackers can enumerate sequential file ids against GET /api/v1/knowledge/file_bbox to retrieve extracted page text from other users' and tenants' knowledge bases.

CVE-2026-111364.description: MinDoc through 2.2-beta.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in DocumentController.Content that allows authenticated users to read documents from unauthorized books. Attackers holding a non-observer role on any book can name that book and iterate sequential document ids to read markdown and HTML from private books.

CVE-2026-111365.description: cool-admin-midway through 8.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows non-superadmin admins to read, modify, or delete other admins' roles by supplying arbitrary role ids. Attackers holding ordinary sys:role permissions can call /admin/sys/role/info, update, or delete with another admin's role id to rewrite menu and department grants, changing other users' effective access.

CVE-2026-111366.description: cool-admin-midway through 8.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows department-limited admins to manage users outside their departments by supplying arbitrary user ids. Attackers holding sys:user:* permissions can call /admin/sys/user/info, update, or delete to read records, reset passwords and roles, or delete accounts.

CVE-2026-111367.description: BillionMail through 4.9 contains a hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge unsubscribe and subscribe-confirm JWTs by computing the key from shipped configuration constants. Attackers can submit forged tokens to /api/unsubscribe, /api/unsubscribe_new, or /api/subscribe/confirm to deactivate any contact or force confirmed subscriptions.

CVE-2026-111368.description: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the Hono API course submission routes that allows course tutors or admins to modify submissions in other courses. Attackers can supply their own course id with another course's submission UUID to PUT or DELETE handlers to overwrite answers, grades, feedback, and grading status or delete submissions.

CVE-2026-111369.description: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the PUT and DELETE /:lessonId lesson routes that allows any course member, including students, to modify lessons. Authenticated students can supply arbitrary lesson ids to change titles and stored HTML content or delete lessons in their course and in other courses and organizations.

CVE-2026-92228.description: The Apache Airflow Keycloak provider's multi-team provisioning (`_attach_team_permissions`) granted every team role global read access to audit logs. Deployments that enable multi-team mode with the Keycloak auth manager and provision teams through it are affected: any authenticated member of one team could read other teams' audit events through the UI or the event-log API. Users of apache-airflow-providers-keycloak are recommended to upgrade to apache-airflow-providers-keycloak 0.11.1 or later.

CVE-2026-94134.description: The Apache Airflow SSH provider hook disables SSH host-key verification by default: unless `host_key` is configured or `no_host_key_check` is explicitly set to false, it accepts any server key. This affects SSH and SFTP connections that rely on the default. An attacker in a machine-in-the-middle position between the worker and the SSH or SFTP server can impersonate the server and capture the credentials or data a task sends. Users of apache-airflow-providers-ssh and apache-airflow-providers-sftp are recommended to upgrade to apache-airflow-providers-ssh 7.0.0 and apache-airflow-providers-sftp 7.0.0 or later. The deferrable SFTP code paths had the same default and are covered separately by CVE-2026-94135; apache-airflow-providers-sftp 7.0.0 fixes both.

CVE-2026-94135.description: The Apache Airflow SFTP provider's deferrable code paths (`SFTPTrigger`, `SFTPHookAsync`, `SFTPClientPool`) disable SSH host-key verification by default unless the connection explicitly sets `no_host_key_check` to false. Deployments that run SFTP sensors or operators in deferrable mode are affected. An attacker in a machine-in-the-middle position between the triggerer and the SFTP server can impersonate the server and capture the credentials or data exchanged. Users of apache-airflow-providers-sftp are recommended to upgrade to apache-airflow-providers-sftp 7.0.0 or later. This is a separate defect from CVE-2026-94134 (the synchronous SSH hook default, which also affects the SFTP hook); users who applied the fix for one also need this release for the other - apache-airflow-providers-sftp 7.0.0 fixes both.

CVE-2026-96806.description: The Apache Airflow Keycloak auth manager did not end the session on logout: the logout route revoked the presented token, but `KeycloakJWTMiddleware` then issued a new, unrevoked token on the same response, so the user stayed logged in. Deployments using the Keycloak auth manager are affected: after a user logs out, anyone with later access to the same browser (for example on a shared workstation) can continue to act as that user. Users of apache-airflow-providers-keycloak are recommended to upgrade to apache-airflow-providers-keycloak 0.11.1 or later.

CVE-2026-111210.description: A vulnerability was determined in bitcoinj up to 0.17. Affected is the function url.openConnection of the file PaymentSession.java of the component Payment Request Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument pki_type can lead to server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-16754.description: A potential improper certificate validation vulnerability was reported in Lenovo Smart Camera C33, distributed exclusively in the Chinese market, that could allow an adjacent user to intercept or manipulate network communications.

CVE-2026-16755.description: A potential vulnerability was reported in Lenovo Smart Camera C33, distributed exclusively in the Chinese market, that could allow an unauthorized remote user to disclose sensitive information.

CVE-2026-75941.description: A potential vulnerability was reported in the Lenovo Legion Zone application, distributed exclusively in the Chinese market, that could allow an attacker on the same logical network to execute arbitrary code.

CVE-2026-84823.description: A flaw was found in WildFly. A user with the `Monitor` role, which is the lowest standard Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) role, can exploit a path traversal vulnerability in the `take-snapshot` operation. By manipulating the `name` parameter, this user can write a copy of the server configuration to an arbitrary location. This allows the `Monitor` role to read back the server configuration, including sensitive credentials, which would otherwise be restricted by RBAC, leading to information disclosure.

CVE-2026-89057.description: A potential authentication bypass vulnerability was reported in some Lenovo tablets that could allow a user with physical access to gain unauthorized device access.

CVE-2026-89062.description: A potential out-of-bounds write vulnerability was reported in the Lenovo Energy Management driver that could allow a local authenticated user to cause a blue screen error.

CVE-2026-92629.description: A potential improper authorization vulnerability was reported in Lenovo Baiying PC Client, distributed exclusively in the Chinese market, that could allow a local authenticated user to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.

CVE-2026-92777.description: A potential vulnerability was reported in some Lenovo Tablets that could allow a user with physical access to an unlocked tablet to bypass device protections and execute arbitrary code.

4b17e27095dbb50399cdb536.title_ko: 에픽게임즈, 런처 웹 프레임워크로 전면 재작성 및 리눅스 포팅 추진
4b17e27095dbb50399cdb536.summary_ko: 에픽게임즈가 기존 언리얼 엔진 기반의 런처를 웹 프레임워크 기반으로 전면 재작성하여 로딩 속도를 향상시켰다. 이 과정에서 바이브코딩을 활용했으며, 향후 네이티브 리눅스 지원도 추가될 예정이다.

81315137075947f4b0fd05ad.title_ko: 센스톤, 과기정통부 피지컬AI 보안 과제서 OT 구간 보안 기술 개발 참여
81315137075947f4b0fd05ad.summary_ko: 센스톤이 과학기술정보통신부의 피지컬AI 기반 다중 계층 보안 기술 개발 국책 과제에 공동연구개발기관으로 참여한다. 회사는 자체 원천기술인 OTAC를 활용해 OT 엔드포인트 보호와 제어 명령 실행 전 통제 체계를 구축할 예정이다.

d7c2361faa2ab8af9d18a8c2.title_ko: 마이크로소프트, AI 기반 게임 이식 및 재창작 연구 위한 'Xbox Labs' 출범
d7c2361faa2ab8af9d18a8c2.summary_ko: 마이크로소프트가 게임 제작자와 연구자로 구성된 Xbox Labs를 출범했다. AI 기반 기술을 활용해 게임을 지원하지 않던 기기에 이식하거나 웹 브라우저에서 실행하는 등의 실험을 진행한다.

341de6460abdb49072161f3f.title_ko: 온라인 광고를 악용하는 이스라엘산 칸디루 스파이웨어 표적 공격
341de6460abdb49072161f3f.summary_ko: 이스라엘산 스파이웨어 칸디루가 온라인 광고를 활용해 언론사 기기를 표적 공격한 사실이 밝혀졌다. 이용자가 광고를 보기만 해도 공격 코드가 작동하는 방식으로, 보안 기업과 연구진의 조사에 따라 관련 광고 업체들은 승인 목록에서 제외되었다.

122120b71a4cdd8f97aec163.title_ko: 스마일샤크, AWS 데이터 컴피턴시 애널리틱스 부문 획득
122120b71a4cdd8f97aec163.summary_ko: 클라우드 AI 관리 전문 기업 스마일샤크가 아마존웹서비스(AWS) 데이터 컴피턴시 애널리틱스 부문을 획득했다. 이를 통해 기업의 데이터 환경 현대화와 AI 인프라 구축을 지원하는 기술 역량을 공식적으로 인정받았다.

a80462bd86ff2730f098a809.title_ko: 미 FBI, 북한 IT 인력 위장 취업을 돕는 '노트북 팜' 대규모 단속
a80462bd86ff2730f098a809.summary_ko: 미국 수사당국이 북한 IT 인력의 위장 취업을 지원하기 위해 회사 지급 노트북을 대신 관리해 온 '노트북 팜' 거점을 대규모로 단속했다. 이번 작전으로 다수의 장비가 압수되고 미국인 조력자 등이 기소되었으며, 70개가 넘는 미국 기업이 위장 취업 피해를 입은 것으로 확인됐다.

4a90c4c0f79775f9e4704a72.title_ko: 엔비디아와 AI4Bharat, 2조 8천억 개 토큰 규모의 인도어 사전학습 데이터 공개
4a90c4c0f79775f9e4704a72.summary_ko: 엔비디아와 IIT 마드라스의 연구실 AI4Bharat가 22개 인도 언어를 아우르는 약 2조 8천억 개의 토큰과 오픈 데이터 생성 파이프라인을 공개했다. 이번 공개는 인도 언어 기반 대규모 언어 모델 연구를 위한 강력한 합성 데이터 자원을 제공한다.

ad165c2c9ab3aa321e008b07.title_ko: 유럽 은행, 외부 협력사가 관리하는 취약한 게이트웨이를 통해 내부망 침입 허용
ad165c2c9ab3aa321e008b07.summary_ko: 유럽의 한 은행이 외부 협력사가 관리하는 인증이 허술한 게이트웨이를 통해 내부망을 침입당한 사실이 팔로알토네트웍스 유닛42 보고서를 통해 공개됐다. 공격자는 내부망 진입 후 관리자 계정을 노리며 중앙 구성 관리 서버의 취약점을 겨냥했으나 보안 솔루션에 의해 차단됐다.

48fa5cf5b50b5a0432b01ffc.title_ko: PortButler: SSH·SFTP·시리얼 콘솔을 통합한 macOS 터미널
48fa5cf5b50b5a0432b01ffc.summary_ko: 개발자가 여러 서버와 임베디드 보드를 동시에 다룰 때 겪는 불편함을 해소하기 위해 SSH, SFTP, 시리얼 프로그램을 하나의 창에서 관리할 수 있도록 만든 macOS용 터미널 도구이다.

4011122f0c7d330a8b435b39.title_ko: 이노뎁·로보티즈AI, 자율주행 순찰로봇 기반 이동형 AI 관제 사업 협력
4011122f0c7d330a8b435b39.summary_ko: 이노뎁과 로보티즈AI가 실외 자율주행 순찰로봇 ‘개미’에 AI 영상분석 및 통합관제 기술을 결합하는 업무협약을 체결했다. 고정형 CCTV의 사각지대를 보완하고 공공·민간의 치안 및 시설 관리 영역으로 영상관제 서비스를 확장할 계획이다.

2ef86a9ca6d091d3d73dfa1d.summary_ko: 오펜시브 보안 기업 티오리가 앤트로픽의 사이버 검증 프로그램 참여 기업으로 승인받았다. 최신 AI 모델을 활용해 자사 모의해킹 플랫폼 ‘진트’의 취약점 탐지 및 공격 경로 검증 엔진을 고도화할 예정이다.

curation.reason_ko: 티오리가 앤트로픽의 고급 사이버 보안 AI 기능 접근권을 제공하는 '사이버 검증 프로그램'에 합류했습니다.

9358c9cfe1347c262e97cd44.title_ko: 빗썸, 유출 정보 악용 피싱·보이스피싱 예방 2차 캠페인 진행
9358c9cfe1347c262e97cd44.summary_ko: 빗썸이 유출된 개인정보를 악용한 2차 금융사기 예방을 위한 캠페인을 진행한다. 사기범이 실제 개인정보를 제시하며 정상 업무인 것처럼 접근해 인증정보를 탈취하는 수법에 주의를 당부했다.

96ec5ce3e98b9a2dc2c9da5d.title_ko: 마케팅 엔지니어: AI 에이전트로 100배 더 많은 실험하기
96ec5ce3e98b9a2dc2c9da5d.summary_ko: 마케팅 엔지니어가 고객 조사, 광고 생성 등의 작업을 여러 AI 에이전트 시스템과 연결해 실행 병목을 극복하는 방법을 다룬다. 아이디어를 빠르게 대량으로 실험하고 실행하는 마케팅 자동화 방식을 소개한다.

summary.title_ko: 앱 동작부터 네이티브 바이너리까지 에이전트로 리버스 엔지니어링하는 도구
summary.summary_ko: 이 저장소는 인공지능 에이전트를 활용해 애플리케이션의 동작 분석부터 네이티브 바이너리 코드에 이르기까지 다양한 대상의 리버스 엔지니어링을 수행하는 도구를 제공한다.
PS5 실행 파일을 리눅스와 윈도우로 자동 포팅하기 위한 도구다.
Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor 등 다양한 AI 코딩 도구를 위한 44가지 편집용 다이어그램 디자인 저장소이다. HTML과 SVG 기반으로 독립 구동되며 깔끔한 시각화 자료를 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: 오픈소스 음성 복제 및 변환 도구 VoiceStudio
summary.summary_ko: VoiceStudio는 646개 언어를 지원하는 오픈소스 로컬 음성 복제 및 변환 도구다. 음성 디자인, 비디오 더빙, 받아쓰기, 오디오북 생성 기능을 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: 브라우저 기반 실시간 공간 정보 시뮬레이터
summary.summary_ko: 이 프로젝트는 실제 데이터를 기반으로 3D 지구본 위에서 실시간 오픈소스 공간 정보를 제공하는 브라우저 기반 시뮬레이터다. 현실적인 시각화와 공간 데이터 탐색 기능을 지원한다.

summary.title_ko: 크로스 플랫폼 Xcode 대체 도구 xtool
summary.summary_ko: xtool은 리눅스, 윈도우, 맥OS 환경에서 Swift 패키지 매니저를 이용해 iOS 앱을 빌드하고 배포할 수 있는 크로스 플랫폼 Xcode 대체 오픈소스 도구다.

summary.title_ko: 저사양 GPU에서 대형 언어 모델을 구동하는 AirLLM
summary.summary_ko: AirLLM은 단일 4GB GPU 환경에서도 2.8T 규모의 대형 언어 모델을 원활하게 추론할 수 있도록 지원하는 오픈소스 도구다. 저사양 하드웨어 제약을 극복하고 대형 모델을 실행할 수 있게 돕는다.
